claims.statement: Jupiter is god of the sky and thunder and king of the gods.
claims.statement_id: Jupiter adalah dewa langit dan guntur serta pemimpin para dewa.
claims.quote: is the god of the sky and thunder, and king of the gods.

claims.statement: Jupiter was the leading deity of Roman state religion in the Republican and Imperial eras.
claims.statement_id: Jupiter adalah dewa utama agama negara Romawi pada zaman republik dan kekaisaran.
claims.quote: Jupiter was the chief deity of Roman state religion throughout the Republican and Imperial eras

claims.statement: The thunderbolt and eagle are Jupiter's emblems.
claims.statement_id: Petir dan elang merupakan lambang Jupiter.
claims.quote: His identifying implement is the thunderbolt and his primary sacred animal is the eagle

claims.statement: Romans viewed Jupiter as a counterpart of Greek Zeus.
claims.statement_id: Orang Romawi memandang Jupiter sebagai padanan Zeus Yunani.
claims.quote: The Romans regarded Jupiter as the equivalent of the Greek Zeus

claims.statement: The title Jupiter Optimus Maximus expressed Jupiter's supreme status.
claims.statement_id: Gelar Jupiter Optimus Maximus menyatakan kedudukan Jupiter sebagai dewa tertinggi.
claims.quote: Jupiter's most important title was Jupiter Optimus Maximus, meaning the Best and Greatest and signifying his role as father of the gods.

claims.statement: Jupiter was held to protect Rome in war and preserve welfare in peace.
claims.statement_id: Jupiter dipercaya melindungi Roma dalam perang dan menjaga kesejahteraan saat damai.
claims.quote: He protected Rome in time of war and maintained the welfare of the people during peace.

claims.statement: Jupiter is depicted with a white beard and an eagle on his scepter.
claims.statement_id: Jupiter digambarkan berjanggut putih dan memiliki lambang elang pada tongkat.
claims.quote: He was most often portrayed with a long, white beard, and his symbol was the eagle atop a scepter

claims.statement: North African Ammon was equated with Jupiter as Jupiter Ammon.
claims.statement_id: Ammon dari Afrika Utara disamakan dengan Jupiter sebagai Jupiter Ammon.
claims.quote: The Romans considered the revered North African oracle Ammon an embodiment of Jupiter, and referred to this syncretic dual divinity as Jupiter Ammon.

claims.statement: Among the many Roman gods, Jupiter, son of Saturn, was the supreme god, associated with thunder, lightning, and storms.
claims.statement_id: Di antara banyak dewa Romawi, Jupiter, putra Saturnus, adalah dewa tertinggi yang dikaitkan dengan guntur, kilat, dan badai.
claims.quote: Among the many gods of the Romans, Jupiter, the son of Saturn, was the supreme god, associated with thunder, lightning, and storms.

claims.statement: The early citizens of Rome added a triad of gods consisting of Mars, Quirinus, and Jupiter as the supreme god.
claims.statement_id: Para dewa baru yang ditambahkan oleh warga awal Roma itu adalah Mars, Quirinus, dan Jupiter sebagai dewa tertinggi.
claims.quote: These new gods included Mars, the god of war; Quirinus, the deified Romulus who watched over the people of Rome; and lastly, Jupiter, the supreme god.

claims.statement: By the Republic, Jupiter was firmly established as the greatest god, and two members of the old triad were replaced by Juno (his sister and wife) and Minerva (his daughter).
claims.statement_id: Pada masa Republik, Jupiter mantap sebagai dewa terbesar, dan dua anggota triad lama diganti dengan Juno (saudari sekaligus istrinya) dan Minerva (putrinya).
claims.quote: By the rise of the Republic, Jupiter's identity as the greatest of all the gods was firmly established, but two members of the old triad were replaced with Juno (his sister and wife) and Minerva (his daughter).

claims.statement: Jupiter was seen as a god of light, protector in defeat, and giver of victory, with the titles Imperator, Invictus, and Triumphator.
claims.statement_id: Jupiter dipandang sebagai dewa cahaya, pelindung saat kekalahan, dan pemberi kemenangan, dengan gelar Imperator, Invictus, dan Triumphator.
claims.quote: He was a god of light, a protector during defeat, and the giver of victory. He was Jupiter Imperator, the supreme general; Jupiter Invictus, the unconquered; and lastly, Jupiter Triumphator.

claims.statement: Jupiter had a reputation for violence: he could punish people with a thunderbolt, but gave a warning first, and punishment was usually carried out with the consent of the other gods.
claims.statement_id: Jupiter dikenal keras: ia dapat menghukum manusia dengan petirnya, tetapi lebih dulu memberi peringatan, dan hukuman biasanya dijatuhkan dengan persetujuan dewa-dewa lain.
claims.quote: As with Zeus, his reputation for violence often caused men to tremble in fear for he could easily punish them with one of his thunderbolts. Of course, he would give them a fair warning before the final, destructive bolt, and punishment was usually carried out only with the consent of the other gods.

claims.statement: Around 509 BCE a magnificent temple shared with Juno and Minerva was built on Capitoline Hill in Rome; it housed a large sculpture of Jupiter and the Sibylline books.
claims.statement_id: Sekitar 509 SM sebuah kuil megah yang dipakai bersama Juno dan Minerva didirikan di Bukit Capitolium di Roma; kuil itu menyimpan arca besar Jupiter dan kitab-kitab Sibylla.
claims.quote: Around 509 BCE a magnificent temple, shared with Juno and Minerva, was erected on Capitoline Hill in Rome, a place where people could gather and make sacrifices. Aside from a large sculpture of Jupiter, the temple, the grandest of all in Rome, housed the Sibylline books

claims.statement: Victorious generals led a triumph procession to Jupiter's temple, made a sacrifice, and donated part of their booty to Jupiter in thanks for victory.
claims.statement_id: Jenderal yang menang berbaris dalam perarakan triumf menuju kuil Jupiter, lalu berkurban dan menyerahkan sebagian rampasan kepada Jupiter sebagai tanda terima kasih atas kemenangan.
claims.quote: After returning from battle, victorious generals would lead a procession called a triumph through the streets of Rome to Jupiter's temple. ... After arriving at the temple, he would make a sacrifice, being sure to donate a portion of his booty to Jupiter, thanking Jupiter for his victory in battle.

claims.statement: The Senate would not permit a declaration of war without Jupiter's blessing, and he was patron of oaths and treaties and punisher of perjurers.
claims.statement_id: Senat tidak mengizinkan pernyataan perang tanpa restu Jupiter, dan ia menjadi pelindung sumpah serta perjanjian sekaligus penghukum pemberi sumpah palsu.
claims.quote: The Senate would not allow a declaration of war without the blessing of Jupiter. He was the patron of oaths and treaties and the punisher of perjurers.

claims.statement: No political action was begun or completed without his judgment, and the Ludi Romani, the chief games held in September, honored him.
claims.statement_id: Menurut sumber ini, tak ada tindakan politik yang dimulai atau diselesaikan tanpa pertimbangannya, dan Ludi Romani yang dirayakan pada bulan September diadakan untuk menghormatinya.
claims.quote: No political action was begun or completed without his judgment. The chief games celebrated in September, the Ludi Romani, were observed in his honor.

claims.statement: Emperor Elagabalus temporarily replaced Jupiter with Elagabal, a Syrian god.
claims.statement_id: Kaisar Elagabalus untuk sementara menggantikan Jupiter dengan Elagabal, dewa Siria.
claims.quote: Emperor Elagabalus temporarily replaced Jupiter with Elagabal, a Syrian god.

claims.statement: In the Capitoline Triad he was the central guardian of the state with Juno and Minerva; his sacred tree was the oak.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Triad Capitolium ia menjadi pelindung utama negara bersama Juno dan Minerva; pohon sucinya adalah pohon ek.
claims.quote: In the Capitoline Triad, he was the central guardian of the state with Juno and Minerva. His sacred tree was the oak.

claims.statement: In the Greek-influenced tradition Jupiter was brother of Neptune and Pluto, each presiding over one of the three realms of the universe: sky, waters, and underworld.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi yang dipengaruhi Yunani, Jupiter adalah saudara Neptunus dan Pluto; masing-masing menguasai satu dari tiga ranah alam semesta: langit, perairan, dan dunia bawah.
claims.quote: In the Greek-influenced tradition, Jupiter was the brother of Neptune and Pluto, the Roman equivalents of Poseidon and Hades respectively. Each presided over one of the three realms of the universe: sky, the waters, and the underworld.

claims.statement: The Latin name Iūpiter or Iuppiter derives from Proto-Italic *djous "day, sky" plus *patēr "father", thus "sky father".
claims.statement_id: Nama Latin Iūpiter atau Iuppiter berasal dari bentuk Proto-Italik *djous "hari, langit" ditambah *patēr "bapak", sehingga berarti "bapak langit".
claims.quote: Iūpiter or Iuppiter, from Proto-Italic *djous "day, sky" + *patēr "father", thus "sky father"

claims.statement: Jove is a less common English formation based on Iov-, the stem of the oblique cases of the Latin name.
claims.statement_id: Jove adalah bentuk bahasa Inggris yang lebih jarang, dibentuk dari Iov-, pangkal kasus oblik nama Latinnya.
claims.quote: Jove is a less common English formation based on Iov-, the stem of oblique cases of the Latin name.

claims.statement: Jupiter took on atmospheric qualities: he is the wielder of lightning and master of weather.
claims.statement_id: Jupiter bersifat atmosferik: ia pemegang kilat dan penguasa cuaca.
claims.quote: Jupiter assumed atmospheric qualities; he is the wielder of lightning and the master of weather.

claims.statement: Jupiter communicates with people through thunder, lightning, and the flight of birds (his auspices), and guards public oaths and compacts and guarantees good faith in the state cult.
claims.statement_id: Jupiter terus berkomunikasi dengan manusia melalui guntur, kilat, dan terbang burung (auspisia-nya), serta menjaga sumpah dan perjanjian publik dan menjamin itikad baik dalam kultus negara.
claims.quote: he is in continual communication with man by means of thunder, lightning and the flight of birds (his auspices). Through his vigilant watch, he is also the guardian of public oaths and compacts and the guarantor of good faith in the State cult.

claims.statement: Wissowa considered Jupiter also a god of war and agriculture, besides his political role as guarantor of good faith.
claims.statement_id: Wissowa menganggap Jupiter juga dewa perang dan pertanian, di samping perannya sebagai penjamin itikad baik.
claims.quote: Wissowa considered Jupiter also a god of war and agriculture, in addition to his political role as guarantor of good faith

claims.statement: Dumézil maintains that Jupiter is not himself a god of war and agriculture, although his actions and interests may extend to those spheres.
claims.statement_id: Dumézil berpendapat Jupiter sendiri bukan dewa perang dan pertanian, meski tindakan dan kepentingannya dapat menjangkau bidang-bidang itu.
claims.quote: Dumézil maintains that Jupiter is not himself a god of war and agriculture, although his actions and interests may extend to these spheres of human endeavour.

claims.statement: The Romans believed Jupiter granted them supremacy because they had honoured him more than any other people had.
claims.statement_id: Orang Romawi percaya Jupiter memberi mereka supremasi karena mereka menghormatinya lebih daripada bangsa lain.
claims.quote: The Romans believed that Jupiter granted them supremacy because they had honoured him more than any other people had.

claims.statement: The consuls swore their oath of office in Jupiter's name and honoured him at the annual feriae of the Capitol in September, sacrificing a white ox with gilded horns.
claims.statement_id: Para konsul bersumpah jabatan atas nama Jupiter dan menghormatinya pada feriae tahunan Capitolium di bulan September, dengan mengurbankan seekor lembu putih bertanduk sepuh.
claims.quote: The consuls swore their oath of office in Jupiter's name, and honoured him on the annual feriae of the Capitol in September. To thank him for his help, and to secure his continued support, they sacrificed a white ox (bos mas) with gilded horns.

claims.statement: Jove was the original namesake of the Latin forms of the weekday now called Thursday in English (originally Iovis Dies in Latin).
claims.statement_id: Jove adalah asal nama bentuk-bentuk Latin untuk hari yang dalam bahasa Inggris kini disebut Thursday (semula Iovis Dies dalam bahasa Latin).
claims.quote: Jove was the original namesake of Latin forms of the weekday now known in English as Thursday (originally called Iovis Dies in Latin).

claims.statement: Tinia is usually regarded as his Etruscan counterpart.
claims.statement_id: Tinia umumnya dianggap sebagai padanan Jupiter dalam tradisi Etruscan.
claims.quote: Tinia is usually regarded as his Etruscan counterpart.

claims.statement: In Roman mythology he negotiates with Numa Pompilius, the second king of Rome, to establish principles of Roman religion such as offering or sacrifice.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Romawi, Jupiter berunding dengan Numa Pompilius, raja kedua Roma, untuk menetapkan asas agama Romawi seperti persembahan atau kurban.
claims.quote: In Roman mythology, he negotiates with Numa Pompilius, the second king of Rome, to establish principles of Roman religion such as offering, or sacrifice.

claims.statement: According to Livy, Tullus found secret rites for Jupiter Elicius but performed them wrongly; Jupiter was angered and burnt up the king and his house with a stroke of lightning.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Livius, Tullus Hostilius menemukan tata cara rahasia untuk Jupiter Elicius, tetapi ia keliru melaksanakannya; Jupiter murka dan membakar sang raja beserta rumahnya dengan sambaran petir.
claims.quote: found there a description of certain secret sacrificial rites paid to Jupiter Elicius ... the anger of Jupiter was roused by the false worship rendered to him, and he burnt up the king and his house by a stroke of lightning. Tullus had achieved great renown in war

claims.statement: In Livy's account Romulus vows a temple to "Jove the Stayer" (Jupiter Stator) as a memorial that the City was saved through Jupiter's help.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Livius, Romulus berjanji mendirikan kuil bagi "Jove sang Penahan" (Jupiter Stator) sebagai pengingat bahwa kota itu selamat berkat pertolongan Jupiter.
claims.quote: Even Romulus was being swept away by the crowd of fugitives, and lifting up his hands to heaven he exclaimed: ‘Jupiter, it was thy omen ... Here do I vow a temple to thee, ‘Jove the Stayer,’ as a memorial for the generations to come that it is through thy present help that the City has been saved.

claims.statement: Romulus then cries out that Jupiter Optimus Maximus bids the Romans stand and renew the battle.
claims.statement_id: Romulus lalu berseru kepada orang Romawi bahwa Jupiter Optimus Maximus memerintahkan mereka bertahan dan melanjutkan pertempuran.
claims.quote: Then, as though he had become aware that his prayer had been heard, he cried, ‘Back, Romans! Jupiter Optimus Maximus bids you stand and renew the battle.

claims.statement: In Livy's account, after leading his victorious army home, the leader mounted to the Capitol with the spoils of his dead foe, hung them on an oak the shepherds held sacred, and marked out the site for Jupiter's temple.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Livius, setelah membawa pasukannya pulang dengan kemenangan, sang pemimpin mendaki Capitolium membawa rampasan dari musuh yang gugur, menggantungnya pada pohon ek yang dianggap suci oleh para gembala, dan menandai lahan kuil Jupiter.
claims.quote: after leading his victorious army home, he mounted to the Capitol with the spoils of his dead foe borne before him on a frame constructed for the purpose. He hung them there on an oak, which the shepherds looked upon as a sacred tree, and at the same time marked out the site for the temple of Jupiter

claims.statement: In Livy's account Romulus addresses the god by a new title, Jupiter Feretrius, offers the arms taken from a king, and dedicates a temple to receive the spolia opima.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Livius, Romulus menyapa sang dewa dengan gelar baru, Jupiter Feretrius, mempersembahkan senjata seorang raja musuh, dan menguduskan sebuah kuil untuk menerima spolia opima.
claims.quote: addressing the god by a new title, uttered the following invocation: ‘Jupiter Feretrius! ... these arms taken from a king, I, Romulus a king and conqueror, bring to thee, and on this domain, whose bounds I have in will and purpose traced, I dedicate a temple to receive the spolia opima

claims.statement: In Ovid's Metamorphoses Jupiter destroys Lycaon's dwelling with thunderbolts as vengeance.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Metamorphoses karya Ovidius, Jupiter menghancurkan kediaman Lycaon dengan petir sebagai pembalasan.
claims.quote: Jove once again broke the deep silence with imperial words; ... this Lycaon mocked their pious vows ... I destroyed his dwelling and his worthless Household Gods, with thunder bolts avenging.

claims.statement: Ganesha is an important Hindu deity.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha termasuk dewa penting dalam agama Hindu.
claims.quote: Ganesha (also Ganesa or Ganapati) is one of the most important gods in Hinduism.

claims.statement: Ganesha is depicted with an elephant head and human body.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha digambarkan dengan kepala gajah dan tubuh manusia.
claims.quote: Ganesha is easily recognized with his elephant head and human body

claims.statement: Ganesha is patron of writers, travellers, students, and commerce, and removes obstacles.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha melindungi penulis, pengelana, pelajar, dan perdagangan serta menyingkirkan rintangan.
claims.quote: Ganesha is the patron of writers, travellers, students, and commerce, and he removes obstacles blocking new projects.

claims.statement: Ganesha is Shiva and Parvati's son and receives offerings before important undertakings.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha adalah putra Shiva dan Parvati dan diberi persembahan sebelum tugas penting dimulai.
claims.quote: The potbellied, elephant-headed Hindu god Ganesha, son of Shiva and Parvati, is venerated throughout India. He is believed to bestow success and abundance through his removal of obstacles. Before any important task is begun, an offering is made to Ganesha.

claims.statement: In one story Shiva had Ganesha's head replaced with an elephant's.
claims.statement_id: Dalam suatu kisah, Shiva mengganti kepala Ganesha dengan kepala gajah.
claims.quote: Repentant, Shiva ordered a new head to be found for the boy and, as the first animal available was an elephant, so Ganesha gained a new elephant head

claims.statement: Ganesha is also worshipped in Jain and Buddhist traditions.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha juga dipuja dalam tradisi Jain dan Buddha.
claims.quote: Ganesha is also worshipped as a principal deity in both Jainism and Buddhism.

claims.statement: In a museum sculpture Ganesha holds a lasso, axe, sweet, and one of his tusks.
claims.statement_id: Pada patung museum Ganesha memegang tali, kapak, manisan, dan gadingnya sendiri.
claims.quote: Here, his upper left hand holds a lasso; the upper right, a battle-ax; the lower left, a sweet; and the lower right, one of his own tusks

claims.statement: Hindu texts mention Ganesha between the first century BCE and the second century CE.
claims.statement_id: Teks Hindu menyebut Ganesha antara abad pertama sebelum Masehi dan abad kedua Masehi.
claims.quote: Ganesha is mentioned in Hindu texts between the 1st century BCE and 2nd century CE

claims.statement: Ganesha is the son of Shiva and Parvati and brother of Karthikeya (Subrahmanya), the god of war; in this account his mother created him from earth moulded into the shape of a boy.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha adalah putra Shiva dan Parvati serta saudara Karthikeya (Subrahmanya), dewa perang; menurut kisah ini ia dibuat ibunya dari tanah yang dibentuk menjadi seorang anak laki-laki.
claims.quote: Ganesha is the son of Shiva and Parvati and he is the brother of Karthikeya (or Subrahmanya), the god of war. He was created by his mother using earth which she moulded into the shape of a boy.

claims.statement: While Shiva was away on meditative wanderings, Parvati set her son as guard while she bathed. Shiva returned, was outraged, and called his bhutaganas, who fought ferociously with the boy.
claims.statement_id: Saat Shiva pergi bertapa, Parvati menempatkan putranya sebagai penjaga ketika ia mandi. Shiva pulang dan murka, lalu memanggil para bhutagana yang bertarung sengit melawan sang anak.
claims.quote: As Shiva was away on his meditative wanderings, Parvati set her new son as guard while she bathed. Unexpectedly, Shiva returned home and, on finding the boy, and outraged at his impudence in claiming he was Parvati's son, Shiva called for his gang of demons, the bhutaganas, who fought ferociously with the boy.

claims.statement: The boy held his own until Vishnu intervened in the form of Maya; while he was distracted by her beauty, the demons, or Shiva himself, cut off his head.
claims.statement_id: Sang anak mampu menahan lawan-lawannya hingga Vishnu turun tangan dalam wujud Maya; saat anak itu terpikat kecantikannya, para bhutagana atau Shiva sendiri memenggal kepalanya.
claims.quote: However, the youngster easily held his own against such fearsome adversaries and Vishnu was forced to intervene in the form of Maya and, whilst the boy was distracted by her beauty, the demons, or Shiva himself, lopped off his head.

claims.statement: As a reward for his courage in fighting the bhutaganas, Shiva made Ganesha their leader, hence his name.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai ganjaran atas keberaniannya melawan para bhutagana, Shiva menjadikan Ganesha pemimpin mereka, dan dari situlah namanya.
claims.quote: As a reward for his great courage in fighting the demons, Shiva made Ganesha the leader of the bhutaganas, hence his name.

claims.statement: A story explaining Ganesha's association with intelligence and wisdom is his competition with Karthikeya to marry first; declared the winner, he married Buddhi and Siddhi, daughters of Prajapati.
claims.statement_id: Kisah yang menjelaskan kaitan Ganesha dengan kecerdasan dan kebijaksanaan adalah perlombaannya dengan Karthikeya untuk menikah lebih dulu; ia dinyatakan menang dan menikahi Buddhi dan Siddhi, putri-putri Prajapati.
claims.quote: A story which explains the god's association with intelligence and wisdom is his competition with Karthikeya to be the first to marry. ... Declared the winner, Ganesha promptly married not one but two daughters of Prajapati: Buddhi (Wisdom) and Siddhi (Success), with whom he had two sons: Kshema and Laabha.

claims.statement: One day, after eating too many modakas (sacrificial cakes), Ganesha rode his giant rat Kroncha to aid his digestion.
claims.statement_id: Suatu hari, setelah memakan terlalu banyak modaka (kue persembahan), Ganesha menunggangi tikus raksasanya, Kroncha, untuk membantu pencernaannya.
claims.quote: One day, after eating a few too many modakas (sacrificial cakes), Ganesha decided to take a ride on his giant rat, Kroncha, to aid his digestion.

claims.statement: In this story Ganesha's belly burst when he fell; he stuffed the cakes back in and wound the snake around his midriff to keep it closed.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah ini perut Ganesha pecah saat ia jatuh, lalu ia memasukkan kembali kue-kuenya dan melilitkan ular di perutnya agar tertutup.
claims.quote: Ganesha landed on his full belly and it burst on hitting the ground. The cakes from his stomach rolled left, right and centre but Ganesha, unperturbed, carefully gathered them in, stuffed them all back into his belly and wound the snake around his midriff to keep it closed.

claims.statement: Outraged at the laughing Moon, Ganesha broke off the end of one of his tusks and hurled it at the Moon's face, which was struck black.
claims.statement_id: Karena murka pada Bulan yang menertawakannya, Ganesha mematahkan ujung salah satu gadingnya dan melemparkannya ke wajah Bulan hingga menghitam.
claims.quote: Outraged, Ganesha broke off the end of one of his tusks and hurled it at the laughing Moon who, hit full in the face, was struck black.

claims.statement: Another explanation of Ganesha's broken tusk is that he snapped it off to transcribe the Mahabharata dictated by the sage Vyasa; this version explains his association with writers and intellectuals.
claims.statement_id: Penjelasan lain tentang gading Ganesha yang patah adalah bahwa ia mematahkannya untuk menyalin Mahabharata yang didiktekan resi Vyasa; versi ini menjelaskan kaitannya dengan penulis dan kaum intelektual.
claims.quote: Yet another but less picturesque explanation of Ganesha's broken tusk was that he snapped it off in order to transcribe the epic poem Mahabharata, dictated by the sage Vyasa who wished to preserve the story for all time. This version explains Ganesha's association with writers and intellectuals.

claims.statement: In his hands he often carries a broken tusk, an axe, a ladle, a noose, prayer beads, and a tray or bowl of sweets, and sometimes an elephant goad to master life's obstacles.
claims.statement_id: Di tangannya ia sering membawa gading patah, kapak, sendok sayur, jerat, untaian doa, serta nampan atau mangkuk manisan, dan kadang pengait gajah untuk menguasai rintangan hidup.
claims.quote: In his hands he often carries a broken tusk, an axe, a ladle, a noose, prayer beads and a tray or bowl of sweets. He sometimes also wields an elephant goad in order to master life's obstacles.

claims.statement: Ganesha is often depicted riding Kroncha, his giant rat, famed for its agility and symbolic of his ability to circumvent obstacles.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha sering digambarkan menunggangi Kroncha, tikus raksasanya yang terkenal lincah dan melambangkan kemampuan sang dewa menghindari rintangan.
claims.quote: Ganesha is often depicted riding Kroncha, his giant rat, famed for its agility and also symbolic of the god's ability to circumvent obstacles.

claims.statement: In Ganguli's translation Vyasa calls Ganesa to mind, "obviator of obstacles" ready to fulfil the desires of his votaries, and Ganesa promptly comes to where Vyasa sits.
claims.statement_id: Dalam terjemahan Ganguli, Vyasa mengingat Ganesa, "penyingkir rintangan" yang siap memenuhi keinginan para pemujanya, dan Ganesa segera datang ke tempat Vyasa duduk.
claims.quote: Then Vyasa began to call to mind Ganesa. And Ganesa, obviator of obstacles, ready to fulfil the desires of his votaries, was no sooner thought of, than he repaired to the place where Vyasa was seated.

claims.statement: Ganesa agrees to be the writer of Vyasa's work provided his pen never ceases; Vyasa asks him to stop writing wherever he does not comprehend, and Ganesa assents by saying Om and begins to write.
claims.statement_id: Ganesa bersedia menjadi penulis karya Vyasa dengan syarat penanya tidak berhenti; Vyasa meminta ia berhenti menulis bila ada yang tidak dipahaminya, dan Ganesa menyetujui dengan mengucapkan Om lalu mulai menulis.
claims.quote: I will become the writer of thy work, provided my pen do not for a moment cease writing. ... Wherever there be anything thou dost not comprehend, cease to continue writing. ... Ganesa having signified his assent, by repeating the word Om! proceeded to write

claims.statement: According to this text even the omniscient Ganesa took a moment to consider, while Vyasa continued to compose many other verses.
claims.statement_id: Menurut teks ini, bahkan Ganesa yang mahatahu sempat berpikir sejenak, sementara Vyasa terus menggubah banyak bait lain.
claims.quote: Even the omniscient Ganesa took a moment to consider; while Vyasa, however, continued to compose other verses in great abundance.

claims.statement: The name Ganesha is a Sanskrit compound of gana, meaning "group, multitude, or categorical system", and isha, meaning "lord or master".
claims.statement_id: Nama Ganesha adalah gabungan kata Sanskerta gana, berarti "kelompok, kumpulan, atau sistem kategori", dan isha, berarti "tuan atau penguasa".
claims.quote: The name Ganesha is a Sanskrit compound, joining the words gana (gaṇa), meaning a 'group, multitude, or categorical system' and isha (īśa), meaning 'lord or master'.

claims.statement: Ganesha, also known as Ganapati, Vinayaka and Pillaiyar, is one of the best-known and most revered deities in the Hindu pantheon and the Supreme god in the Ganapatya sect.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha juga dikenal sebagai Ganapati, Vinayaka, dan Pillaiyar; ia salah satu dewa Hindu yang paling terkenal dan dipuja, serta Dewa Tertinggi dalam sekte Ganapatya.
claims.quote: also known as Ganapati, Vinayaka and Pillaiyar, is one of the best-known and most revered and worshipped deities in the Hindu pantheon and is the Supreme god in the Ganapatya sect.

claims.statement: Ganesha also holds the title "Pratham Pujya", the god to be worshipped first before any other deity.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha juga bergelar "Pratham Pujya", dewa yang dipuja lebih dulu sebelum pemujaan dewa lain.
claims.quote: Ganesha also holds the Title of "Pratham Pujya" (the god to be worshipped initially before the worship of any other Deity).

claims.statement: As god of beginnings Ganesha is honoured at the start of rites and ceremonies, and invoked during writing sessions as patron of letters and learning.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai dewa permulaan, Ganesha dihormati pada awal upacara dan ritus; ia juga diseru saat menulis sebagai pelindung huruf dan ilmu.
claims.quote: As the god of beginnings, he is honoured at the start of rites and ceremonies. Ganesha is also invoked during writing sessions as a patron of letters and learning.

claims.statement: The principal texts on Ganesha include the Ganesha Purana, the Mudgala Purana, and the Ganapati Atharvasirsha.
claims.statement_id: Teks-teks utama tentang Ganesha mencakup Ganesha Purana, Mudgala Purana, dan Ganapati Atharvasirsha.
claims.quote: The principal texts on Ganesha include the Ganesha Purana, the Mudgala Purana, and the Ganapati Atharvasirsha.

claims.statement: The Amarakosha, an early Sanskrit lexicon, lists eight synonyms of Ganesha, including Vinayaka, Vighnarāja, Dvaimātura (one who has two mothers), Gaṇādhipa, and Ekadanta (one who has one tusk).
claims.statement_id: Amarakosha, kamus Sanskerta awal, mencantumkan delapan sinonim Ganesha, di antaranya Vinayaka, Vighnarāja, Dvaimātura (berbunda dua), Gaṇādhipa, dan Ekadanta (bergading satu).
claims.quote: The Amarakosha, an early Sanskrit lexicon, lists eight synonyms of Ganesha: Vinayaka, Vighnarāja (equivalent to Vighnesha), Dvaimātura (one who has two mothers), Gaṇādhipa (equivalent to Ganapati and Ganesha), Ekadanta (one who has one tusk)

claims.statement: Ganesha is popularly worshipped as a remover of obstacles, though traditionally he also places obstacles in the path of those who need to be checked; hence he is often worshipped before beginning anything new.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha dipuja secara populer sebagai penyingkir rintangan, meski menurut tradisi ia juga menaruh rintangan di jalan orang yang perlu dihentikan; karena itu ia sering dipuja sebelum memulai sesuatu yang baru.
claims.quote: He is popularly worshipped as a remover of obstacles, though traditionally he also places obstacles in the path of those who need to be checked. Hence, he is often worshipped by the people before they begin anything new.

claims.statement: The earliest images and mentions list Ganesha as a major deity in present-day Indonesia, Thailand, Cambodia, and Vietnam, dating to the 7th and 8th centuries and mirroring Indian examples of the 5th century or earlier.
claims.statement_id: Gambar dan sebutan paling awal mencatat Ganesha sebagai dewa utama di wilayah Indonesia, Thailand, Kamboja, dan Vietnam masa kini, berasal dari abad ke-7 dan ke-8, dan mencerminkan contoh India abad ke-5 atau lebih awal.
claims.quote: The earliest images and mention lists Ganesha as a major deity in present-day Indonesia, Thailand, Cambodia and Vietnam dating to the 7th and 8th centuries, and these mirror Indian examples of the 5th century or earlier.

claims.statement: Some texts say Ganesha was born with an elephant head, but in most stories he acquires it later; the most recurrent motif is that Parvati created him from clay and Shiva beheaded him.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian teks menyebut Ganesha lahir berkepala gajah, tetapi dalam kebanyakan kisah ia memperolehnya kemudian; motif paling sering adalah Parvati menciptakannya dari tanah liat dan Shiva memenggalnya.
claims.quote: While some texts say that Ganesha was born with an elephant head, he acquires the head later in most stories. The most recurrent motif in these stories is that Ganesha was created by Parvati using clay to protect her and Shiva beheaded him when Ganesha came between Shiva and Parvati.

claims.statement: Another story says Ganesha was created directly by Shiva's laughter; because Shiva considered him too alluring, he gave him an elephant head and a protruding belly.
claims.statement_id: Kisah lain menyebut Ganesha tercipta langsung dari tawa Shiva; karena Shiva menganggapnya terlalu memikat, ia memberinya kepala gajah dan perut buncit.
claims.quote: Another story says that Ganesha was created directly by Shiva's laughter. Because Shiva considered Ganesha too alluring, he gave him the head of an elephant and a protruding belly.

claims.statement: Ganesha's earliest name was Ekadanta (One Tusked), referring to his single whole tusk, the other being broken; some of the earliest images show him holding his broken tusk.
claims.statement_id: Nama paling awal Ganesha adalah Ekadanta (Bergading Satu), merujuk pada satu gading utuhnya karena yang lain patah; beberapa arca paling awal memperlihatkannya memegang gading patah itu.
claims.quote: Ganesha's earliest name was Ekadanta (One Tusked), referring to his single whole tusk, the other being broken. Some of the earliest images of Ganesha show him holding his broken tusk.

claims.statement: In the standard configuration Ganesha typically holds an axe or a goad in one upper arm and a pasha (noose) in the other.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wujud baku, Ganesha biasanya memegang kapak atau pengait di satu lengan atas dan pasha (jerat) di lengan atas lainnya.
claims.quote: In the standard configuration, Ganesha typically holds an axe or a goad in one upper arm and a pasha (noose) in the other upper arm.

claims.statement: Ganesha is often shown riding on or attended by a mouse; per Martin-Dubost the rat began to appear as principal vehicle in sculptures in central and western India during the 7th century.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha sering digambarkan menunggangi atau ditemani seekor tikus; menurut Martin-Dubost, tikus mulai tampil sebagai kendaraan utama dalam arca Ganesha di India tengah dan barat pada abad ke-7.
claims.quote: Ganesha is often shown riding on or attended by a mouse. ... Martin-Dubost says that the rat began to appear as the principal vehicle in sculptures of Ganesha in central and western India during the 7th century; the rat was always placed close to his feet.

claims.statement: Devotees offer Ganesha sweets such as modaka and small sweet balls called laddus; he is often shown carrying a bowl of sweets called a modakapātra.
claims.statement_id: Para pemuja mempersembahkan manisan seperti modaka dan bola manis kecil bernama laddu kepada Ganesha; ia sering digambarkan membawa mangkuk manisan yang disebut modakapātra.
claims.quote: Devotees offer Ganesha sweets such as modaka and small sweet balls called laddus. He is often shown carrying a bowl of sweets, called a modakapātra.

claims.statement: An annual festival honours Ganesha for ten days, starting on Ganesh Chaturthi in late August or early September, beginning with clay idols brought in to symbolise the god's visit.
claims.statement_id: Festival tahunan menghormati Ganesha selama sepuluh hari, dimulai pada Ganesh Chaturthi yang biasanya jatuh pada akhir Agustus atau awal September, dengan membawa masuk arca tanah liat sebagai lambang kunjungan sang dewa.
claims.quote: An annual festival honours Ganesha for ten days, starting on Ganesh Chaturthi, which typically falls in late August or early September. The festival begins with people bringing in clay idols of Ganesha, symbolising the god's visit.

claims.statement: In 1893 Lokmanya Tilak transformed this annual Ganesha festival from private family celebrations into a grand public event.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1893, Lokmanya Tilak mengubah festival tahunan Ganesha dari perayaan keluarga yang bersifat pribadi menjadi acara publik yang besar.
claims.quote: In 1893, Lokmanya Tilak transformed this annual Ganesha festival from private family celebrations into a grand public event.

claims.statement: As god of transitions Ganesha is placed at the doorway of many Hindu temples to keep out the unworthy, analogous to his role as Parvati's doorkeeper.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai dewa peralihan, Ganesha ditempatkan di pintu banyak kuil Hindu untuk menolak yang tak layak, selaras dengan perannya sebagai penjaga pintu Parvati.
claims.quote: As the god of transitions, he is placed at the doorway of many Hindu temples to keep out the unworthy, which is analogous to his role as Parvati's doorkeeper.

claims.statement: The eight Ashtavinayak shrines lie within a 100-kilometre radius of Pune; each celebrates a particular form of Ganapati with its own lore: Morgaon, Siddhatek, Pali, Mahad, Theur, Lenyadri, Ozar, and Ranjangaon.
claims.statement_id: Delapan kuil Ashtavinayak terletak dalam radius 100 kilometer dari kota Pune; masing-masing merayakan satu bentuk Ganapati dengan kisahnya sendiri: Morgaon, Siddhatek, Pali, Mahad, Theur, Lenyadri, Ozar, dan Ranjangaon.
claims.quote: Located within a 100-kilometer radius of the city of Pune, each of the eight shrines celebrates a particular form of Ganapati, complete with its own lore. The eight shrines are: Morgaon, Siddhatek, Pali, Mahad, Theur, Lenyadri, Ozar and Ranjangaon.

claims.statement: Ganesha appeared in his classic form as a clearly recognizable deity with well-defined iconographic attributes in the early 4th to 5th centuries CE.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha tampil dalam wujud klasiknya sebagai dewa yang mudah dikenali dengan atribut ikonografi yang jelas pada awal abad ke-4 hingga ke-5 M.
claims.quote: Ganesha appeared in his classic form as a clearly-recognizable deity with well-defined iconographic attributes in the early 4th to 5th centuries CE.

claims.statement: An independent cult with Ganesha as the primary deity was well established by about the 10th century.
claims.statement_id: Kultus mandiri dengan Ganesha sebagai dewa utama telah mapan pada sekitar abad ke-10.
claims.quote: An independent cult with Ganesha as the primary deity was well established by about the 10th century.

claims.statement: Devotees believe that if Ganesha is propitiated he grants success, prosperity, and protection against adversity.
claims.statement_id: Para pemuja percaya bahwa bila Ganesha diambil hatinya, ia memberi keberhasilan, kemakmuran, dan perlindungan dari kesulitan.
claims.quote: Devotees believe that if Ganesha is propitiated, he grants success, prosperity and protection against adversity.

claims.statement: Ganesha is a non-sectarian deity: Hindus of all denominations invoke him at the start of prayers, important undertakings, and ceremonies, and dancers and musicians, particularly in southern India, begin performances with a prayer to him.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha dipandang sebagai dewa lintas sekte: umat Hindu dari semua aliran menyerunya pada awal doa, kegiatan penting, dan upacara; penari dan pemusik, terutama di India selatan, memulai pertunjukan dengan doa kepadanya.
claims.quote: Ganesha is a non-sectarian deity. Hindus of all denominations invoke him at the beginning of prayers, important undertakings, and religious ceremonies. Dancers and musicians, particularly in southern India, begin art performances such as the Bharatanatyam dance with a prayer to Ganesha.

claims.statement: Among predominantly Muslim Indonesians Ganesha is not worshipped but seen as a symbol of knowledge, wisdom, and education, and many Indonesian public universities feature his likeness in their grounds or logo.
claims.statement_id: Di kalangan orang Indonesia yang mayoritas beragama Islam, Ganesha tidak dipuja tetapi dipandang sebagai simbol pengetahuan, kebijaksanaan, dan pendidikan; banyak universitas negeri Indonesia memuat gambarnya di kampus atau logo.
claims.quote: Amongst Indonesians who predominantly profess the Islamic faith, Ganesha is not worshipped, but seen as a symbol of knowledge, wisdom and education. Many Indonesian public universities feature Ganesha's likeness in their grounds or logo.

claims.statement: Statues of Ganesha are found throughout the region of Maritime Southeast Asia, often beside Shiva sanctuaries; his forms in the Hindu art of the Philippines, Java, Bali, and Borneo show specific regional influences.
claims.statement_id: Arca Ganesha ditemukan di seluruh kawasan Asia Tenggara maritim, sering di samping tempat suci Shiva; bentuk Ganesha dalam seni Hindu di Filipina, Jawa, Bali, dan Kalimantan menunjukkan pengaruh khas daerah.
claims.quote: Statues of Ganesha are found throughout the region, often beside Shiva sanctuaries. The forms of Ganesha found in the Hindu art of the Philippines, Java, Bali, and Borneo show specific regional influences.

claims.statement: In Japan, where Ganesha is known as Kangiten, the Ganesha cult was first mentioned in 806.
claims.statement_id: Di Jepang, tempat Ganesha dikenal sebagai Kangiten, kultus Ganesha pertama kali disebut pada 806.
claims.quote: In Japan, where Ganesha is known as Kangiten, the Ganesha cult was first mentioned in 806.

claims.statement: One of his popular forms, Heramba-Ganapati, has five elephant heads, and other less common variations in the number of heads are known.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu bentuk populernya, Heramba-Ganapati, berkepala gajah lima, dan variasi lain jumlah kepala yang lebih jarang diketahui.
claims.quote: One of his popular forms, Heramba-Ganapati, has five elephant heads, and other less-common variations in the number of heads are known.

claims.statement: Ganesha's name is written गणेश in Sanskrit, with the IAST transliteration Gaṇeśa.
claims.statement_id: Nama Ganesha dalam bahasa Sanskerta ditulis गणेश, dengan transliterasi IAST Gaṇeśa.
claims.quote: Ganesha, or Ganesh (Sanskrit: गणेश, IAST: Gaṇeśa

claims.statement: Ganesha is mentioned in Hindu texts between the 1st century BCE and 2nd century CE, and a few Ganesha images from the 4th and 5th centuries CE have been documented by scholars.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha disebut dalam teks Hindu antara abad ke-1 SM dan abad ke-2 M, dan beberapa arca Ganesha dari abad ke-4 dan ke-5 M telah didokumentasikan para sarjana.
claims.quote: Ganesha is mentioned in Hindu texts between the 1st century BCE and 2nd century CE, and a few Ganesha images from the 4th and 5th centuries CE have been documented by scholars.

claims.statement: Of the eight incarnations of Ganesha in the Mudgala Purana, he uses a mouse named Mushaka in five, a lion as Vakratunda, a peacock as Vikata, and Shesha, the divine serpent, as Vighnaraja.
claims.statement_id: Dari delapan inkarnasi Ganesha dalam Mudgala Purana, ia memakai tikus bernama Mushaka pada lima inkarnasi, singa sebagai Vakratunda, merak sebagai Vikata, dan Shesha sang ular ilahi sebagai Vighnaraja.
claims.quote: Of the eight incarnations of Ganesha described in the Mudgala Purana, Ganesha uses a mouse (shrew) named Mushaka in five of them, a lion in his incarnation as Vakratunda, a peacock in his incarnation as Vikata, and Shesha, the divine serpent, in his incarnation as Vighnaraja.

claims.statement: Michael, also called Archangel Michael or Michael the Taxiarch, is an archangel and the warrior of God in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, and is venerated as a saint in some Christian traditions.
claims.statement_id: Michael, juga disebut Archangel Michael atau Michael the Taxiarch, adalah malaikat agung dan pejuang Tuhan dalam agama Yahudi, Kristen, dan Islam, dan dihormati sebagai orang kudus dalam sebagian tradisi Kristen.
claims.quote: Michael, also called Archangel Michael or Michael the Taxiarch, is an archangel and the warrior of God in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam while additionally being venerated as a saint in some Christian traditions.

claims.statement: The earliest surviving mentions of his name are in third- and second-century BC Jewish works, where he is chief of the angels and archangels.
claims.statement_id: Penyebutan nama Michael tertua yang masih ada terdapat dalam karya-karya Yahudi abad ke-3 dan ke-2 SM, yang menyebutnya pemimpin para malaikat dan malaikat agung.
claims.quote: The earliest surviving mentions of his name are in third- and second-century BC Jewish works, often but not always apocalyptic, where he is the chief of the angels and archangels

claims.statement: He is the guardian prince of ancient Israel, responsible for the care of the Israelites.
claims.statement_id: Ia adalah pangeran pelindung Israel kuno dan bertanggung jawab memelihara bangsa Israel.
claims.quote: he is the guardian prince of ancient Israel and is responsible for the care of the Israelites

claims.statement: The Book of Enoch lists Michael as one of seven archangels, with Uriel, Raguel, Raphael, Sariel, Gabriel, and Remiel.
claims.statement_id: Kitab Henokh (Book of Enoch) mendaftar Michael sebagai salah satu dari tujuh malaikat agung, bersama Uriel, Raguel, Raphael, Sariel, Gabriel, dan Remiel.
claims.quote: The Book of Enoch lists Michael as one of seven archangels (the remaining names are Uriel, Raguel, Raphael, Sariel, Gabriel, and Remiel)

claims.statement: In Islam, Michael, or Mīkāʾīl, is one of the four archangels along with Jibril (Gabriel), with whom he is often paired, Israfil, and Azrail.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Islam, Michael atau Mīkāʾīl adalah salah satu dari empat malaikat agung bersama Jibril (Gabriel), yang sering dipasangkan dengannya, Israfil, dan Azrail.
claims.quote: In Islam, Michael, or Mīkāʾīl, is one of the four archangels along with Jibril (Gabriel, with whom he is often paired), ʾIsrāfīl (trumpeter angel) and ʿAzrāʾīl (angel of death).

claims.statement: In Islamic literature, Michael is associated with mercy and asks God for forgiveness for humans.
claims.statement_id: Dalam literatur Islam, Michael dikaitkan dengan rahmat dan memohon ampun kepada Tuhan bagi manusia.
claims.quote: In further Islamic literature, Michael is associated with mercy. He asks God for forgiveness for humans

claims.statement: As the angel who carries out God's providence, he is associated with natural phenomena and causes rain upon the lands.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai malaikat pelaksana pemeliharaan Tuhan, ia dikaitkan dengan gejala alam dan menurunkan hujan ke daratan.
claims.quote: As the angel to effectuate God's providence he is also associated with natural phenomena and causes rain upon the lands.

claims.statement: Unlike in Christian tradition, in Islam Michael is rarely portrayed as a warrior angel.
claims.statement_id: Berbeda dengan tradisi Kristen, dalam Islam Michael jarang digambarkan sebagai malaikat pejuang.
claims.quote: Unlike Christian tradition, Michael is rarely portrayed as a warrior-angel

claims.statement: The Hebrew name Michael means "Who is like God?"; he is one of the principal angels, and his name was the war-cry of the good angels in the battle in heaven.
claims.statement_id: Nama Michael dalam bahasa Ibrani berarti "Who is like God?" (Siapa yang seperti Allah?); ia salah satu malaikat utama, dan namanya menjadi seruan perang para malaikat baik dalam pertempuran di surga.
claims.quote: (Hebrew "Who is like God?"). St. Michael is one of the principal angels; his name was the war-cry of the good angels in the battle fought in heaven against the enemy and his followers.

claims.statement: According to the Catholic Encyclopedia, Christian tradition gives Michael four offices, including fighting against Satan and rescuing the souls of the faithful from the power of the enemy, especially at the hour of death.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Catholic Encyclopedia (Ensiklopedia Katolik), tradisi Kristen memberi Michael empat tugas, antara lain melawan Satan dan menyelamatkan jiwa orang beriman dari kuasa musuh, terutama pada saat kematian.
claims.quote: Following these Scriptural passages, Christian tradition gives to St. Michael four offices: To fight against Satan. To rescue the souls of the faithful from the power of the enemy, especially at the hour of death.

claims.statement: Michael is the champion of God's people, the Jews in the Old Law and the Christians in the New Testament, and therefore the patron of the Church.
claims.statement_id: Michael adalah pembela umat Tuhan, orang Yahudi dalam Hukum Lama dan orang Kristen dalam Perjanjian Baru, sehingga ia menjadi pelindung Gereja.
claims.quote: To be the champion of God's people, the Jews in the Old Law, the Christians in the New Testament; therefore he was the patron of the Church

claims.statement: In art, Michael is represented as an angelic warrior fully armed with helmet, sword, and shield, standing over the dragon, which he sometimes pierces with a lance.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni, Michael digambarkan sebagai malaikat pejuang bersenjata lengkap dengan helm, pedang, dan perisai, berdiri di atas naga yang kadang ditusuknya dengan tombak.
claims.quote: In art St. Michael is represented as an angelic warrior, fully armed with helmet, sword, and shield (often the shield bears the Latin inscription: Quis ut Deus), standing over the dragon, whom he sometimes pierces with a lance.

claims.statement: He also holds a pair of scales in which he weighs the souls of the departed.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga memegang timbangan untuk menimbang jiwa orang yang telah meninggal.
claims.quote: He also holds a pair of scales in which he weighs the souls of the departed

claims.statement: The Greek Liturgy styles him Archistrategos, "highest general".
claims.statement_id: Liturgi Yunani menyebutnya Archistrategos, "panglima tertinggi" (highest general).
claims.quote: The Greek Liturgy styles him Archistrategos, "highest general"

claims.statement: In Normandy, Michael is the patron of mariners at his famous sanctuary at Mont-Saint-Michel in the Diocese of Coutances.
claims.statement_id: Di Normandia, Michael adalah pelindung para pelaut di tempat sucinya yang terkenal di Mont-Saint-Michel, Keuskupan Coutances.
claims.quote: In Normandy St. Michael is the patron of mariners in his famous sanctuary at Mont-Saint-Michel in the Diocese of Coutances.

claims.statement: Well known is the apparition of Michael (a. 494 or 530-40) at his renowned sanctuary on Monte Gargano, as related in the Roman Breviary.
claims.statement_id: Terkenal kisah penampakan Michael (tahun 494 atau 530-40) di tempat sucinya yang termasyhur di Monte Gargano, sebagaimana diceritakan dalam Brevir Romawi (Roman Breviary).
claims.quote: Well known is the apparition of St. Michael (a. 494 or 530-40), as related in the Roman Breviary, 8 May, at his renowned sanctuary on Monte Gargano

claims.statement: Early Christians gave Michael the care of their sick; in Phrygia, where he was first venerated, his prestige as angelic healer obscured his role in military affairs.
claims.statement_id: Pemeluk Kristen awal menyerahkan perawatan orang sakit kepada Michael; di Frigia (Phrygia), tempat ia pertama dihormati, kemasyhurannya sebagai penyembuh malaikat mengalahkan perannya dalam urusan militer.
claims.quote: but to St. Michael they gave the care of their sick. At the place where he was first venerated, in Phrygia, his prestige as angelic healer obscured his interposition in military affairs.

claims.statement: St. Basil and other Greek Fathers, as well as Salmeron and Bellarmine, place Michael over all the angels.
claims.statement_id: St. Basil, para Bapa Gereja Yunani lain, Salmeron, dan Bellarmine menempatkan Michael di atas semua malaikat.
claims.quote: St. Basil (Hom. de angelis) and other Greek Fathers, also Salmeron, Bellarmine, etc., place St. Michael over all the angels

claims.statement: Early Jewish writings, and very frequently the Book of Enoch, designate Michael as "the prince of Israel".
claims.statement_id: Tulisan Yahudi awal, dan sangat sering Kitab Henokh (Book of Enoch), menyebut Michael "the prince of Israel" (pemimpin Israel).
claims.quote: Michael is specially designated in early Jewish writings and very frequently in the Book of Enoch as "the prince of Israel"

claims.statement: As "the advocate of the Jews", Michael is represented as the angel of forbearance and mercy.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai "the advocate of the Jews" (pembela orang Yahudi), Michael digambarkan sebagai malaikat kesabaran dan belas kasihan.
claims.quote: "the advocate of the Jews." It is for this reason that he is represented as the angel of forbearance and mercy

claims.statement: Michael is opposed particularly to Samael, Israel's accuser; his enmity with Samael dates from when Samael was thrown down from heaven.
claims.statement_id: Michael bermusuhan terutama dengan Samael, penuduh Israel; permusuhan itu bermula ketika Samael dicampakkan dari surga.
claims.quote: particularly with Samael, Israel's accuser. His enmity with Samael dates from the time when the latter was thrown down from heaven.

claims.statement: In Arabic literature Michael is called "Mika'il" or, in the Koran, "Mikal", and he is one of the four archangels.
claims.statement_id: Dalam literatur Arab, Michael disebut "Mika'il" atau, dalam Al-Qur'an (Koran), "Mikal", dan ia salah satu dari empat malaikat agung.
claims.quote: Michael is called in Arabic literature "Mika'il" or (in the Koran) "Mikal." He is one of the four archangels

claims.statement: In the Haggadah, Michael is represented as the most prominent of the archangels.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Haggadah, Michael digambarkan sebagai malaikat agung yang paling menonjol.
claims.quote: Michael should be represented in the Haggadah as the most prominent of the archangels

claims.statement: According to the Jewish Encyclopedia, the idea that Michael is the Charon of individual souls, common among Christians, is not found in Jewish sources.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Jewish Encyclopedia, gagasan bahwa Michael adalah pengantar (Charon) jiwa-jiwa perorangan, yang umum di kalangan Kristen, tidak ditemukan dalam sumber Yahudi.
claims.quote: The idea that Michael is the Charon of individual souls, which is common among Christians, is not found in Jewish sources

claims.statement: According to Revelation, there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Kitab Wahyu (Revelation), terjadi perang di surga: Michael dan para malaikatnya berperang melawan naga, dan naga beserta malaikat-malaikatnya berperang.
claims.quote: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

claims.statement: The great dragon, that old serpent called the Devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world, was cast out into the earth.
claims.statement_id: Naga besar itu, ular tua yang disebut Iblis (Devil) dan Satan, yang menyesatkan seluruh dunia, dicampakkan ke bumi.
claims.quote: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth

claims.statement: In the Book of Daniel, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help the messenger who remained there with the kings of Persia.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Kitab Daniel, Michael, salah satu pemimpin utama (chief princes), datang menolong utusan yang tertahan di hadapan raja-raja Persia.
claims.quote: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

claims.statement: At that time Michael shall stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of thy people.
claims.statement_id: Pada waktu itu Michael akan bangkit, pemimpin agung (great prince) yang membela anak-anak bangsamu.
claims.quote: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people

claims.statement: According to the Epistle of Jude, Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil about the body of Moses, did not dare bring a railing accusation against him, but said, "The Lord rebuke thee."
claims.statement_id: Menurut Surat Yudas (Epistle of Jude), Michael sang malaikat agung, ketika berbantah dengan Iblis tentang jenazah Musa (body of Moses), tidak berani menghujatnya, tetapi berkata, "The Lord rebuke thee."
claims.quote: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

claims.statement: According to St. Thomas, Michael is the prince of the last and lowest choir, the angels.
claims.statement_id: Menurut St. Thomas, Michael adalah pemimpin paduan terakhir dan terendah, yaitu para malaikat.
claims.quote: But, according to St. Thomas (Summa Ia.113.3) he is the prince of the last and lowest choir, the angels.

claims.statement: The Hebrew name מִיכָאֵל, romanized Mīḵāʾēl, literally means 'Who is like El [God]?'.
claims.statement_id: Nama Ibrani (Hebrew) מִיכָאֵל, dilatinkan Mīḵāʾēl, secara harfiah berarti 'Who is like El [God]?' (Siapa yang seperti El [Allah]?).
claims.quote: Hebrew: מִיכָאֵל, romanized: Mīḵāʾēl, lit. 'Who is like El [God]?'

claims.statement: According to Exodus Rabbah (Ex. R. xviii. 5), as recorded by the Jewish Encyclopedia, Michael destroyed the army of Sennacherib.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Exodus Rabbah (Ex. R. xviii. 5), sebagaimana dicatat Jewish Encyclopedia, Mikhael menghancurkan pasukan Sanherib.
claims.quote: Michael destroyed the army of Sennacherib (Ex. R. xviii. 5).

claims.statement: According to Eliezer b. Jacob (Gen. R. xliv. 16), it was Michael who rescued Abraham from the furnace into which Nimrod had thrown him.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Eliezer b. Jacob (Gen. R. xliv. 16), Mikhaellah yang menyelamatkan Abraham dari tungku yang ke dalamnya ia dilemparkan oleh Nimrod.
claims.quote: Thus, according to Eliezer b. Jacob, it was Michael who rescued Abraham from the furnace into which he had been thrown by Nimrod (Gen. R. xliv. 16).

claims.statement: According to Abravanel (on Ex. xxiii. 20), Michael led the Israelites during their forty years of wandering in the wilderness.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Abravanel (pada Ex. xxiii. 20), Mikhael memimpin bangsa Israel selama empat puluh tahun pengembaraan mereka di padang gurun.
claims.quote: Michael led the Israelites during their forty years' wandering in the wilderness (Abravanel to Ex. xxiii. 20).

claims.statement: Michael endeavored to prevent Israel from being led into captivity by Nebuchadnezzar and to save the Temple from destruction, but the sins of the people were so great that he was powerless to carry out his purposes.
claims.statement_id: Mikhael berusaha mencegah Israel dibawa ke pembuangan oleh Nebukadnezar dan menyelamatkan Bait Suci dari kehancuran, tetapi dosa umat begitu besar sehingga ia tidak berdaya mewujudkan maksudnya.
claims.quote: He endeavored also to prevent Israel from being led into captivity by Nebuchadnezzar and to save the Temple from destruction; but the sins of the people were so great that he was powerless to carry his purposes into effect.

claims.statement: According to Yalkut on Lamentations (Yalḳ., Lam. 1009), Michael and Gabriel pleaded for the Israelites, who were nevertheless doomed, and the two angels were themselves compelled to set the Temple on fire.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Yalkut pada Ratapan (Yalḳ., Lam. 1009), Mikhael dan Gabriel membela orang Israel, tetapi mereka telah dijatuhi hukuman, dan kedua malaikat itu sendiri terpaksa membakar Bait Suci.
claims.quote: According to Yalḳ., Lam. 1009, Michael and Gabriel pleaded for the Israelites, who, however, were doomed, and the two angels were themselves compelled to set the Temple on fire.

claims.statement: Samael will be subdued by Michael; but when Michael asks God to help Israel, God will say that Israel should turn toward Him, be it only as far as the point of a needle.
claims.statement_id: Samael akan ditaklukkan Mikhael; tetapi ketika Mikhael memohon agar Allah menolong Israel, Allah akan menjawab bahwa Israel harus berpaling kepada-Nya, sekalipun hanya sejauh ujung jarum.
claims.quote: Samael will be subdued by Michael; but when the latter asks God to help Israel, God will say, "Israel should turn toward Me, be it only as far as the point of a needle."

claims.statement: At the resurrection Michael will sound the trumpet, at which the graves will open and the dead will rise.
claims.statement_id: Pada kebangkitan, Mikhael akan meniup sangkakala, sehingga kubur-kubur terbuka dan orang mati bangkit.
claims.quote: At the resurrection Michael will sound the trumpet, at which the graves will open and the dead will rise

claims.statement: Michael is called the viceroy of God, who rules over the world (Enoch lxix. 14 et seq.), and wherever Michael appears the Shekinah is also to be found (Ex. R. ii. 8).
claims.statement_id: Mikhael disebut wakil Allah yang memerintah dunia (Henokh lxix. 14 dst.), dan di mana pun Mikhael tampak, Shekinah juga ada (Ex. R. ii. 8).
claims.quote: He is the viceroy of God, who rules over the world (Enoch, lxix. 14 et seq.), and wherever Michael appears the Shekinah also is to be found (Ex. R. ii. 8).

claims.statement: As an angel of nature, Michael is represented as being of the element of water, on account of which he is the prince of water.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai malaikat alam, Mikhael digambarkan berunsur air, dan karena itu ia adalah pangeran air.
claims.quote: As an angel of nature, Michael is represented as of the element of water, on account of which he is the prince of water

claims.statement: One of the four offices Christian tradition gives to Michael is to call men's souls away from earth and bring them to judgment.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu dari empat tugas Mikhael dalam tradisi Kristen adalah memanggil jiwa manusia dari bumi dan membawanya ke penghakiman.
claims.quote: Christian tradition gives to St. Michael four offices: ... To call away from earth and bring men's souls to judgment

claims.statement: The Fathers say Michael is often meant in Scripture without being named: they identify him as the cherub at the gate of paradise, the angel who stood in the way against Balaam, and the angel who routed the army of Sennacherib (2 Kings 19:35).
claims.statement_id: Menurut para Bapa Gereja, Mikhael sering dimaksud dalam Kitab Suci tanpa disebut namanya: ia dikenali sebagai kerub di gerbang firdaus, malaikat yang menghadang Bileam, dan malaikat yang menghalau pasukan Sanherib (2 Raja-raja 19:35).
claims.quote: They say he was the cherub who stood at the gate of paradise ... the angel who stood in the way against Balaam (Numbers 22:22 sqq.), the angel who routed the army of Sennacherib (2 Kings 19:35).

claims.statement: According to the tradition at Colossae, pagans directed a stream against Michael's sanctuary to destroy it, but the archangel split the rock by lightning to give the stream a new bed, and sanctified forever the waters that came from the gorge.
claims.statement_id: Menurut tradisi di Kolose, orang kafir mengarahkan sebuah aliran air ke tempat suci Mikhael untuk menghancurkannya, tetapi sang malaikat agung membelah batu dengan petir sehingga air itu mengalir di jalur baru, dan ia menguduskan air dari ngarai itu untuk selamanya.
claims.quote: The pagans directed a stream against the sanctuary of St. Michael to destroy it, but the archangel split the rock by lightning to give a new bed to the stream, and sanctified forever the waters which came from the gorge.

claims.statement: According to a legend the Catholic Encyclopedia calls possibly apocryphal, Michael appeared over the Moles Hadriani (Castel di S. Angelo) during the procession St. Gregory held against the pestilence, putting an end to the plague.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda yang oleh Catholic Encyclopedia disebut mungkin apokrif, Mikhael tampak di atas Moles Hadriani (Castel di S. Angelo) saat prosesi Santo Gregorius melawan wabah, dan mengakhiri wabah itu.
claims.quote: According to an (apocryphal?) legend of the tenth century he appeared over the Moles Hadriani (Castel di S. Angelo), in 950, during the procession which St. Gregory held against the pestilence, putting an end to the plague.

claims.statement: The Lombards of Sipontum (Manfredonia) attributed their victory over the Greek Neapolitans on 8 May 663 to Michael's intercession.
claims.statement_id: Orang Lombardia di Sipontum (Manfredonia) menganggap kemenangan mereka atas orang Napoli Yunani pada 8 Mei 663 sebagai hasil syafaat Mikhael.
claims.quote: To his intercession the Lombards of Sipontum (Manfredonia) attributed their victory over the Greek Neapolitans, 8 May, 663.

claims.statement: In the Book of Enoch (Charles translation) the Lord orders Michael to bind Semjaza and his associates who united themselves with women, binding them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth until the day of their judgement.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Kitab Henokh (terjemahan Charles), Tuhan memerintahkan Mikhael untuk mengikat Semjaza dan para sekutunya yang bersatu dengan perempuan, mengikat mereka selama tujuh puluh generasi di lembah-lembah bumi sampai hari penghakiman mereka.
claims.quote: Go, bind Semjâzâ and his associates who have united themselves with women ... bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation

claims.statement: Quran 2:98 (Sahih International translation) states that whoever is an enemy to Allah, His angels, His messengers, Gabriel and Michael, then indeed Allah is an enemy to the disbelievers.
claims.statement_id: Al-Qur'an 2:98 (terjemahan Sahih International) menyatakan bahwa siapa pun yang menjadi musuh Allah, malaikat-malaikat-Nya, rasul-rasul-Nya, Jibril, dan Mikail, maka Allah adalah musuh bagi orang-orang kafir.
claims.quote: Whoever is an enemy to Allah and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, Allah is an enemy to the disbelievers.

claims.statement: According to 2 Kings 19:35, the angel of the LORD went out and smote an hundred fourscore and five thousand (185,000) in the camp of the Assyrians; by morning they were all dead corpses. The text does not name Michael.
claims.statement_id: Menurut 2 Raja-raja 19:35, malaikat TUHAN keluar dan memukul seratus delapan puluh lima ribu orang di perkemahan orang Asyur (185.000); pagi harinya semuanya sudah menjadi mayat. Teks ini tidak menyebut nama Mikhael.
claims.quote: the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

claims.statement: In Daniel 12:1, at the time Michael stands up there shall be a time of trouble such as never was since there was a nation, and at that time the people shall be delivered.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Daniel 12:1, pada saat Mikhael bangkit akan ada masa kesusahan yang belum pernah terjadi sejak ada bangsa, dan pada waktu itu umat itu akan diselamatkan.
claims.quote: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered

claims.statement: In European folklore vampires are undead humanlike creatures.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Eropa vampir adalah makhluk mirip manusia yang hidup kembali.
claims.quote: In European folklore, vampires are undead humanoid creatures that visit loved ones and cause mischief or deaths in the neighbourhoods they inhabited while they were alive.

claims.statement: A vampire was believed to leave the grave at night to drink living people's blood.
claims.statement_id: Vampir diyakini keluar dari kubur malam hari dan mengisap darah orang hidup.
claims.quote: In the first-mentioned meaning a vampire is usually supposed to be the soul of a dead man which quits the buried body by night to suck the blood of living persons.

claims.statement: To put a stop to a vampire's ravages, a stake is driven through the corpse, the head cut off, or the heart torn out and the body burned.
claims.statement_id: Untuk menghentikan kerusakan yang ditimbulkan vampir, pasak ditancapkan ke jasadnya, kepalanya dipenggal, atau jantungnya dicabut dan tubuhnya dibakar.
claims.quote: To put a stop to his ravages, a stake is driven through the -corpse, or the head cut off, or the heart torn out and the body burned

claims.statement: Polish burials had sickles or stones placed on the bodies.
claims.statement_id: Makam di Polandia ditemukan dengan sabit atau batu yang ditaruh di tubuh jasad.
claims.quote: They all had either sickles placed across their neck or body or large rocks stacked under their chin

claims.statement: Vampire scares often followed contagious deaths and further deaths nearby.
claims.statement_id: Kepanikan vampir sering mengikuti kematian akibat penyakit menular dan kematian beruntun.
claims.quote: vampire scares usually began when a person died – often of a contagious disease, and in New England almost always of tuberculosis – and others in the vicinity began dying

claims.statement: Bram Stoker's Dracula appeared in 1897 and influenced the vampire image.
claims.statement_id: Novel Dracula karya Bram Stoker diterbitkan pada tahun 1897 dan berpengaruh pada citra vampir.
claims.quote: the pre-eminent vampire novel in history: Dracula by Bram Stoker, published in 1897.

claims.statement: Vampires were usually reported as bloated and ruddy, purplish, or dark in colour, characteristics often attributed to the recent drinking of blood.
claims.statement_id: Vampir biasanya dilaporkan berperut kembung dengan warna kemerahan, keunguan, atau gelap, yang sering dianggap akibat darah yang baru diminum.
claims.quote: Vampires were usually reported as bloated in appearance, and ruddy, purplish, or dark in colour; these characteristics were often attributed to the recent drinking of blood

claims.statement: The vampire would be clad in the linen shroud it was buried in, and its teeth, hair, and nails may have grown somewhat, though in general fangs were not a feature.
claims.statement_id: Vampir dikatakan mengenakan kain kafan linen tempat ia dikubur; gigi, rambut, dan kukunya mungkin tumbuh sedikit, tetapi pada umumnya taring bukan cirinya.
claims.quote: It would be clad in the linen shroud it was buried in, and its teeth, hair, and nails may have grown somewhat, though in general fangs were not a feature.

claims.statement: Corpses thought to be vampires were generally described as healthier-looking than expected, plump, with little or no sign of decomposition.
claims.statement_id: Jasad yang diduga vampir umumnya digambarkan tampak lebih sehat dari perkiraan, gemuk, dan hanya sedikit atau tanpa tanda pembusukan.
claims.quote: Corpses thought to be vampires were generally described as having a healthier appearance than expected, plump and showing little or no signs of decomposition.

claims.statement: Signs of vampire activity included the death of cattle, sheep, relatives, or neighbours; folkloric vampires could also make their presence felt through poltergeist-styled activity such as hurling stones on roofs, moving household objects, and pressing on sleepers.
claims.statement_id: Tanda vampir aktif di suatu tempat mencakup kematian ternak, kerabat, atau tetangga; vampir dalam cerita rakyat juga dapat membuat kehadirannya terasa lewat gangguan ala poltergeist, seperti melempar batu ke atap, menggeser perabot, dan menindih orang yang tidur.
claims.quote: Evidence that a vampire was active in a given locality included death of cattle, sheep, relatives or neighbours. Folkloric vampires could also make their presence felt by engaging in minor poltergeist-styled activity, such as hurling stones on roofs or moving household objects, and pressing on people in their sleep.

claims.statement: Garlic is a common apotropaic; wild rose and hawthorn branches are sometimes associated with harming vampires, and in Europe mustard seeds were sprinkled on roofs to keep them away; other apotropaics include crucifix, rosary, and holy water.
claims.statement_id: Bawang putih adalah contoh penangkal yang umum; ranting mawar liar dan hawthorn kadang dikaitkan dengan melukai vampir, dan di Eropa biji sawi ditaburkan di atap rumah untuk menjauhkannya; penangkal lain mencakup salib, rosario, dan air suci.
claims.quote: Garlic is a common example; a branch of wild rose and hawthorn are sometimes associated with causing harm to vampires, and in Europe, mustard seeds would be sprinkled on the roof of a house to keep them away. Other apotropaics include sacred items, such as crucifix, rosary, or holy water.

claims.statement: Some folklore states that vampires cannot walk on consecrated ground, such as that of churches or temples, or cross running water.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian cerita rakyat menyatakan vampir tidak dapat berjalan di tanah yang disucikan, seperti gereja atau kuil, atau menyeberangi air mengalir.
claims.quote: Some folklore also states that vampires are unable to walk on consecrated ground, such as that of churches or temples, or cross running water.

claims.statement: Some traditions hold that a vampire cannot enter a house unless invited; folkloric vampires were believed more active at night but were not generally considered vulnerable to sunlight.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian tradisi menyatakan vampir tak dapat memasuki rumah tanpa diundang pemiliknya; vampir dalam cerita rakyat dipercaya lebih aktif pada malam hari tetapi umumnya tidak dianggap rentan terhadap sinar matahari.
claims.quote: Some traditions also hold that a vampire cannot enter a house unless invited by the owner; after the first invitation they can come and go as they please. Though folkloric vampires were believed to be more active at night, they were not generally considered vulnerable to sunlight.

claims.statement: Methods of destroying suspected vampires varied, with staking the most commonly cited, particularly in South Slavic cultures.
claims.statement_id: Cara membinasakan tersangka vampir beragam, dengan penusukan pasak sebagai cara yang paling sering disebut, terutama dalam budaya Slavia Selatan.
claims.quote: Methods of destroying suspected vampires varied, with staking the most commonly cited method, particularly in South Slavic cultures.

claims.statement: Decapitation was the preferred method in German and western Slavic areas, with the head buried between the feet, behind the buttocks, or away from the body.
claims.statement_id: Pemenggalan kepala menjadi cara yang disukai di wilayah Jerman dan Slavia barat, dengan kepala dikubur di antara kaki, di belakang bokong, atau jauh dari tubuh.
claims.quote: Decapitation was the preferred method in German and western Slavic areas, with the head buried between the feet, behind the buttocks or away from the body.

claims.statement: Other common European methods included severing the tendons at the knees or scattering poppy seeds, millet, or sand at a presumed vampire's grave to keep it busy all night counting the grains.
claims.statement_id: Cara lain yang lazim di Eropa mencakup memotong urat lutut atau menaburkan biji poppy, millet, atau pasir di kuburan tersangka vampir agar ia sibuk menghitung butiran sepanjang malam.
claims.quote: Other methods commonly practised in Europe included severing the tendons at the knees or placing poppy seeds, millet, or sand on the ground at the grave site of a presumed vampire; this was intended to keep the vampire occupied all night by counting the fallen grains

claims.statement: Burying a corpse upside-down was widespread, as was placing objects such as scythes or sickles near the grave to satisfy any demons entering the body or to appease the dead so it would not wish to rise from its coffin.
claims.statement_id: Menguburkan jenazah dengan posisi terbalik lazim, begitu pula menaruh benda seperti arit atau sabit di dekat makam untuk memuaskan setan yang memasuki jasad atau menenangkan orang mati agar tak ingin bangkit dari peti.
claims.quote: Burying a corpse upside-down was widespread, as was placing earthly objects, such as scythes or sickles, near the grave to satisfy any demons entering the body or to appease the dead so that it would not wish to arise from its coffin.

claims.statement: Romani people drove steel or iron needles into a corpse's heart and placed bits of steel in the mouth, over the eyes, ears, and between the fingers at burial.
claims.statement_id: Orang Romani menancapkan jarum baja atau besi ke jantung jenazah dan menaruh potongan baja di mulut, di atas mata, telinga, dan di sela jari saat penguburan.
claims.quote: Romani people drove steel or iron needles into a corpse's heart and placed bits of steel in the mouth, over the eyes, ears and between the fingers at the time of burial.

claims.statement: In most cases vampires are revenants of evil beings, suicide victims, or witches, but they can also be created by a malevolent spirit possessing a corpse or by a vampire's bite.
claims.statement_id: Pada umumnya vampir adalah arwah yang kembali dari makhluk jahat, korban bunuh diri, atau penyihir, tetapi vampir juga dapat tercipta lewat roh jahat yang merasuki jasad atau lewat gigitan vampir.
claims.quote: In most cases, vampires are revenants of evil beings, suicide victims, or witches, but they can also be created by a malevolent spirit possessing a corpse or by being bitten by a vampire.

claims.statement: Local variants in Southeastern Europe were known by different names, such as shtriga in Albania, vrykolakas in Greece, and strigoi in Romania.
claims.statement_id: Varian lokal di Eropa Tenggara dikenal dengan nama berbeda, seperti shtriga di Albania, vrykolakas di Yunani, dan strigoi di Rumania.
claims.quote: Local variants in Southeastern Europe were also known by different names, such as shtriga in Albania, vrykolakas in Greece and strigoi in Romania, cognate with Italian strega, meaning 'witch'.

claims.statement: It is almost universally accepted that the modern English word vampire traces back through South Slavic languages, namely Bulgarian or Serbian, to at least Proto-Slavic.
claims.statement_id: Hampir diterima secara universal bahwa kata vampire dalam bahasa Inggris modern berasal melalui bahasa Slavia Selatan, yaitu Bulgaria atau Serbia, hingga sekurang-kurangnya Proto-Slavia.
claims.quote: it is almost universally accepted that the modern English word vampire traces back through South Slavic languages, namely Bulgarian or Serbian, to at least Proto-Slavic.

claims.statement: The panic began with an outbreak of alleged vampire attacks in East Prussia in 1721 and in the Habsburg monarchy from 1725 to 1734, spreading to other localities.
