claims.statement_id: Kepanikan bermula dari gelombang dugaan serangan vampir di Prusia Timur pada 1721 dan di Monarki Habsburg pada 1725 hingga 1734, lalu menyebar ke tempat lain.
claims.quote: The panic began with an outbreak of alleged vampire attacks in East Prussia in 1721 and in the Habsburg monarchy from 1725 to 1734, which spread to other localities.

claims.statement: The controversy in Austria ended when Empress Maria Theresa sent her physician Gerard van Swieten to investigate; he concluded vampires did not exist and the Empress passed laws prohibiting the opening of graves and the desecration of bodies.
claims.statement_id: Kontroversi di Austria berakhir ketika Permaisuri Maria Theresa mengutus dokter pribadinya, Gerard van Swieten, menyelidiki klaim itu; ia menyimpulkan vampir tidak ada dan sang permaisuri melarang pembukaan makam dan penodaan jenazah.
claims.quote: The controversy in Austria ceased when Empress Maria Theresa sent her personal physician, Gerard van Swieten, to investigate the claims of vampiric entities. Van Swieten concluded that vampires did not exist and the Empress passed laws prohibiting the opening of graves and the desecration of bodies, thus ending the vampire epidemic.

claims.statement: The charismatic and sophisticated vampire of modern fiction was born in 1819 with the publication of "The Vampyre" by the English writer John Polidori.
claims.statement_id: Vampir fiksi modern yang karismatik dan canggih lahir pada 1819 lewat terbitnya "The Vampyre" karya penulis Inggris John Polidori.
claims.quote: The charismatic and sophisticated vampire of modern fiction was born in 1819 with the publication of "The Vampyre" by the English writer John Polidori

claims.statement: The most famous and most recently recorded case of suspected vampirism is that of nineteen-year-old Mercy Brown, who died in Exeter, Rhode Island, in 1892; her father, assisted by the family physician, removed her from her tomb two months later, cut out her heart, and burned it to ashes.
claims.statement_id: Kasus dugaan vampirisme yang paling terkenal dan terbaru tercatat adalah Mercy Brown, 19 tahun, yang meninggal di Exeter, Rhode Island, pada 1892; ayahnya, dibantu dokter keluarga, mengeluarkannya dari makam dua bulan kemudian, mengambil jantungnya, dan membakarnya hingga jadi abu.
claims.quote: The most famous, and most recently recorded, case of suspected vampirism is that of nineteen-year-old Mercy Brown, who died in Exeter, Rhode Island, in 1892. Her father, assisted by the family physician, removed her from her tomb two months after her death, cut out her heart and burned it to ashes.

claims.statement: In the Middle Ages the Christian Churches reinterpreted vampires from their earlier folk existence into minions of Satan.
claims.statement_id: Pada Abad Pertengahan, Gereja-Gereja Kristen menafsirkan ulang vampir dari wujud rakyatnya semula menjadi antek Setan.
claims.quote: In the Middle Ages, the Christian Churches reinterpreted vampires from their previous folk existence into minions of Satan

claims.statement: Tales of supernatural beings consuming the blood or flesh of the living have been found in nearly every culture around the world for many centuries.
claims.statement_id: Kisah makhluk gaib yang menyantap darah atau daging orang hidup ditemukan di hampir setiap budaya di dunia selama berabad-abad.
claims.quote: Tales of supernatural beings consuming the blood or flesh of the living have been found in nearly every culture around the world for many centuries.

claims.statement: In Turkic folklore an ubır is a vampiric creature with varied regional depictions that can shape-shift into humans and various animals.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Turkik, ubır adalah makhluk mirip vampir dengan berbagai penggambaran daerah, yang dapat berubah wujud menjadi manusia maupun berbagai hewan.
claims.quote: In Turkic folklore, an ubır is a vampiric creature characterized by various regional depictions. ... An ubır possesses the ability to shape-shift, assuming the forms of both humans and various animals.

claims.statement: A kuntilanak or matianak in Indonesia, or pontianak or langsuir in Malaysia, is a woman who died in childbirth and became undead, seeking revenge and terrorising villages.
claims.statement_id: Kuntilanak atau matianak di Indonesia, atau pontianak atau langsuir di Malaysia, adalah perempuan yang meninggal saat melahirkan lalu menjadi undead, mencari balas dendam dan meneror desa.
claims.quote: A kuntilanak or matianak in Indonesia, or pontianak or langsuir in Malaysia, is a woman who died during childbirth and became undead, seeking revenge and terrorising villages.

claims.statement: The Malaysian penanggalan can detach her fanged head, which flies at night looking for blood, typically from pregnant women; Malaysians hung jeruju (thistles) around doors and windows so she would not enter for fear of catching her intestines on the thorns.
claims.statement_id: Penanggalan Malaysia dapat melepaskan kepalanya yang bertaring dan terbang malam hari mencari darah, biasanya dari perempuan hamil; orang Malaysia menggantung jeruju (duri) di pintu dan jendela agar ia tak masuk karena takut ususnya tersangkut.
claims.quote: She is able to detach her fanged head which flies around in the night looking for blood, typically from pregnant women. Malaysians hung jeruju (thistles) around the doors and windows of houses, hoping the penanggalan would not enter for fear of catching its intestines on the thorns.

claims.statement: Jiangshi, sometimes called "Chinese vampires" by Westerners, are reanimated corpses that hop around, killing living creatures to absorb life essence (qì) from their victims.
claims.statement_id: Jiangshi, kadang disebut "vampir Tiongkok" oleh orang Barat, adalah mayat yang dihidupkan kembali dan melompat-lompat, membunuh makhluk hidup untuk menyerap esensi kehidupan (qì) korbannya.
claims.quote: Jiangshi, sometimes called "Chinese vampires" by Westerners, are reanimated corpses that hop around, killing living creatures to absorb life essence (qì) from their victims.

claims.statement: Folkloric vampires wear shrouds and are often described as bloated with ruddy or dark countenance, in contrast to the modern gaunt, pale vampire dating from the early 19th century.
claims.statement_id: Vampir folklor mengenakan kain kafan dan sering digambarkan kembung dengan wajah kemerahan atau gelap, berbeda dengan vampir modern yang kurus dan pucat yang berasal dari awal abad ke-19.
claims.quote: They wear shrouds and are often described as bloated and of ruddy or dark countenance, contrasting with the modern gaunt, pale vampire which dates from the early 19th century.

claims.statement: In modern fiction the vampire tends to be depicted as a suave, charismatic villain.
claims.statement_id: Dalam fiksi modern, vampir cenderung digambarkan sebagai penjahat yang luwes dan karismatik.
claims.quote: In modern fiction, the vampire tends to be depicted as a suave, charismatic villain.

claims.statement: Early folk belief in vampires has sometimes been ascribed to ignorance of the body's decomposition after death, with pre-industrial societies creating the vampire to explain the mysteries of death.
claims.statement_id: Kepercayaan rakyat awal pada vampir kadang dikaitkan dengan ketidaktahuan tentang proses pembusukan tubuh setelah kematian, sehingga masyarakat praindustri menciptakan sosok vampir untuk menjelaskan misteri kematian.
claims.quote: Early folk belief in vampires has sometimes been ascribed to the ignorance of the body's process of decomposition after death and how people in pre-industrial societies tried to rationalize this, creating the figure of the vampire to explain the mysteries of death.

claims.statement: The exact etymology is unclear; the term vampire is first recorded in English in the 18th century or arguably the late 17th century.
claims.statement_id: Etimologi pastinya tidak jelas; istilah vampire pertama kali tercatat dalam bahasa Inggris pada abad ke-18 atau, bisa dikatakan, akhir abad ke-17.
claims.quote: The exact etymology is unclear. The term vampire finds its earliest record in English in the 18th century or arguably the late 17th century.

claims.statement: The word is spelled Vampyre in its first prominent English-language appearance in the 1730s, in news reports about vampire panics in eastern Europe such as the 1725 Serbian panic.
claims.statement_id: Kata ini dieja Vampyre pada kemunculan prominen pertamanya dalam bahasa Inggris pada 1730-an, dalam berita tentang kepanikan vampir di Eropa timur seperti kepanikan Serbia tahun 1725.
claims.quote: It is spelled Vampyre in its first prominent English-language appearance in the 1730s, in news reports about vampire panics in eastern Europe, such as the 1725 Serbian panic.

claims.statement: According to this encyclopedia, those who turn vampire are generally wizards, witches, suicides, and those who met a violent end or were cursed by their parents or the church.
claims.statement_id: Menurut ensiklopedia ini, orang yang menjadi vampir umumnya adalah penyihir, korban bunuh diri, mereka yang mati secara kekerasan, atau yang dikutuk orang tua atau gereja.
claims.quote: The persons who turn vampires are generally wizards, witches, suicides and those who have come to a violent end or have been cursed by their parents or by the church.

claims.statement: Anyone may become a vampire if an animal (especially a cat) leaps over his corpse or a bird flies over it.
claims.statement_id: Siapa pun dapat menjadi vampir bila seekor hewan (terutama kucing) melompati jasadnya atau seekor burung terbang di atasnya.
claims.quote: But any one may become a vampire if an animal (especially a cat) leaps over his corpse or a bird flies over it.

claims.statement: When a vampire's grave is opened, his corpse is found fresh and rosy from the blood he has absorbed.
claims.statement_id: Bila makam vampir dibuka, jasadnya ditemukan segar dan kemerahan oleh darah yang diserapnya.
claims.quote: his corpse is found to be fresh and rosy from the blood which he has thus absorbed.

claims.statement: Sometimes the vampire is thought to be the soul of a living man that leaves his body in sleep, in the form of a straw or fluff of down, to suck the blood of other sleepers.
claims.statement_id: Kadang vampir dianggap jiwa orang hidup yang meninggalkan tubuhnya saat tidur, dalam wujud jerami atau gumpalan bulu, untuk mengisap darah orang lain yang sedang tidur.
claims.quote: Sometimes the vampire is thought to be the soul of a living man which leaves his body in sleep, to go in the form of a straw or fluff of down and suck the blood of other sleepers.

claims.statement: The belief in vampires chiefly prevails in Slavonic lands such as Russia, Poland, and Servia and among the Czechs of Bohemia, and it became especially prevalent in Hungary between 1730 and 1735.
claims.statement_id: Kepercayaan pada vampir terutama berkembang di negeri-negeri Slavia, seperti Rusia, Polandia, dan Serbia, serta di antara orang Ceko Bohemia; ia sangat marak di Hungaria antara 1730 dan 1735.
claims.quote: The belief in vampires chiefly prevails in Slavonic lands, as in Russia (especially White Russia and the Ukraine), Poland and Servia, and among the Czechs of Bohemia and the other Slavonic races of Austria. It became specially prevalent in Hungary between the years 1730 and 1735

claims.statement: According to this encyclopedia the superstition probably gained ground from reports of those who examined the bodies of persons buried alive though believed to be dead.
claims.statement_id: Menurut ensiklopedia ini, takhayul tersebut mungkin berkembang dari laporan orang yang memeriksa jasad orang yang dikubur hidup-hidup tetapi dianggap sudah mati.
claims.quote: It is probable that this superstition gained much ground from the reports of those who had examined the bodies of persons buried alive though believed to be dead

claims.statement: The term vampire is apparently of Servian origin (wampir) and was originally applied in eastern Europe to blood-sucking ghosts.
claims.statement_id: Istilah vampire tampaknya berasal dari Serbia (wampir) dan semula dipakai di Eropa timur untuk hantu penghisap darah.
claims.quote: a term, apparently of Servian origin (wampir), originally applied in eastern Europe to blood-sucking ghosts.

claims.statement: Ares is a Greek god of war and courage, an Olympian and son of Zeus and Hera.
claims.statement_id: Ares adalah dewa perang dan keberanian Yunani, salah satu dewa Olimpus dan putra Zeus serta Hera.
claims.quote: is the Greek god of war and courage. He is one of the Twelve Olympians, and the son of Zeus and Hera.

claims.statement: Ares is an Olympian deity associated with war and courage.
claims.statement_id: Ares adalah dewa Olimpus yang berkaitan dengan perang dan keberanian.
claims.quote: ARES was the Olympian god of war, battlelust, courage and civil order.

claims.statement: Ancient art shows Ares armored with helmet, shield, and spear.
claims.statement_id: Ares digambarkan memakai zirah dan ketopong serta membawa perisai dan tombak.
claims.quote: In ancient Greek Archaic and Classical art, Ares is most often depicted wearing full armour and helmet and carrying a shield and spear.

claims.statement: Hephaistos trapped Ares and Aphrodite in a golden net.
claims.statement_id: Hephaistos menjebak Ares dan Aphrodite dalam jaring emas.
claims.quote: Ares had an adulterous affair with the goddess Aphrodite but her husband Hephaistos trapped the pair in a golden net

claims.statement: Twin giants confined Ares in a bronze vessel until Hermes freed him.
claims.statement_id: Raksasa kembar mengurung Ares di bejana perunggu sampai Hermes membebaskannya.
claims.quote: They imprisoned the god in a bronze jar (or cauldron) for one year and he was only freed through the intervention of Hermes.

claims.statement: Romans identified Mars with Ares.
claims.statement_id: Orang Romawi menyamakan Mars dengan Ares.
claims.quote: The Romans identified their god Mars with the Greek Ares.

claims.statement: Ancient depictions show Ares as a bearded warrior or a helmeted youth with spear.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran kuno Ares dapat berupa prajurit dewasa berjanggut atau pemuda berketopong dan tombak.
claims.quote: In ancient Greek art he was depicted as either a mature, bearded warrior armed for battle, or a nude, beardless youth with a helm and spear.

claims.statement: The etymology of the name Ares is traditionally connected with the Greek word ἀρή (arē), the Ionic form of Doric ἀρά (ara), "bane, ruin, curse, imprecation".
claims.statement_id: Etimologi nama Ares secara tradisional dikaitkan dengan kata Yunani ἀρή (arē), bentuk Ionia dari ἀρά (ara) Doria, yang berarti "bencana, kehancuran, kutukan".
claims.quote: The etymology of the name Ares is traditionally connected with the Greek word ἀρή (arē), the Ionic form of the Doric ἀρά (ara), "bane, ruin, curse, imprecation".

claims.statement: Ares's name shows Mycenaean origins, but his reputation for savagery was thought by some to reflect his likely origins as a Thracian deity.
claims.statement_id: Nama Ares menunjukkan asal-usul Mikenai, tetapi reputasinya yang buas oleh sebagian orang dianggap mencerminkan asalnya sebagai dewa Thrakia.
claims.quote: Although Ares's name shows his origins as Mycenaean, his reputation for savagery was thought by some to reflect his likely origins as a Thracian deity.

claims.statement: Many Greeks were ambivalent toward Ares: he embodies the physical valor needed for success in war but can also personify sheer brutality and bloodlust, in contrast to his sister Athena, whose martial functions include strategy and generalship.
claims.statement_id: Banyak orang Yunani bersikap mendua terhadap Ares: ia mewujudkan keberanian fisik yang diperlukan untuk menang perang, tetapi juga dapat melambangkan kebrutalan dan nafsu darah, berbeda dengan saudarinya Athena yang berfungsi pada strategi dan kepemimpinan militer.
claims.quote: Many Greeks were ambivalent towards him. He embodies the physical valor necessary for success in war but can also personify sheer brutality and bloodlust, in contrast to his sister Athena, whose martial functions include military strategy and generalship.

claims.statement: An association with Ares endows places, objects, and other deities with a savage, dangerous, or militarized quality.
claims.statement_id: Keterkaitan dengan Ares memberi tempat, benda, dan dewa lain sifat buas, berbahaya, atau militeristik.
claims.quote: An association with Ares endows places, objects, and other deities with a savage, dangerous, or militarized quality.

claims.statement: Although there are many literary allusions to Ares's love affairs and children, he has a limited role in Greek mythology, and when he appears he is often humiliated.
claims.statement_id: Meski banyak sindiran sastra tentang asmara dan anak-anak Ares, perannya dalam mitologi Yunani terbatas, dan bila muncul ia sering dipermalukan.
claims.quote: Although there are many literary allusions to Ares's love affairs and children, he has a limited role in Greek mythology. When he does appear, he is often humiliated.

claims.statement: Enyalios was sometimes identified with Ares and sometimes differentiated from him as another war god with a separate cult, even in the same town.
claims.statement_id: Enyalios kadang disamakan dengan Ares dan kadang dibedakan sebagai dewa perang lain dengan kultus tersendiri, bahkan di kota yang sama.
claims.quote: Enyalios was sometimes identified with Ares and sometimes differentiated from him as another war god with separate cult, even in the same town

claims.statement: There was an archaic Spartan statue of Ares in chains in the temple of Enyalios, which Pausanias claimed meant the spirit of war and victory was to be kept in the city.
claims.statement_id: Ada arca arkais Ares dalam belenggu di kuil Enyalios di Sparta, yang menurut Pausanias berarti semangat perang dan kemenangan harus ditahan di kota itu.
claims.quote: There was an archaic Spartan statue of Ares in chains in the temple of Enyalios (sometimes regarded as the son of Ares, sometimes as Ares himself), which Pausanias claimed meant that the spirit of war and victory was to be kept in the city.

claims.statement: Some cities in Greece and several in Asia Minor held annual festivals to bind and detain him as their protector, and in parts of Asia Minor he was an oracular deity.
claims.statement_id: Beberapa kota di Yunani dan beberapa di Asia Kecil mengadakan festival tahunan untuk mengikat dan menahan Ares sebagai pelindung mereka; di sebagian Asia Kecil ia menjadi dewa orakel.
claims.quote: Some cities in Greece and several in Asia Minor held annual festivals to bind and detain him as their protector. In parts of Asia Minor, he was an oracular deity.

claims.statement: Further from Greece, the Scythians were said to ritually kill one in a hundred prisoners of war as an offering to their equivalent of Ares.
claims.statement_id: Lebih jauh dari Yunani, bangsa Skithia dikatakan membunuh satu dari setiap seratus tawanan perang secara ritual sebagai persembahan bagi padanan Ares mereka.
claims.quote: Still further away from Greece, the Scythians were said to ritually kill one in a hundred prisoners of war as an offering to their equivalent of Ares.

claims.statement: The later belief that ancient Spartans offered human sacrifice to Ares may owe more to mythical prehistory, misunderstandings, and reputation than to reality.
claims.statement_id: Kepercayaan belakangan bahwa orang Sparta kuno mengurbankan manusia kepada Ares mungkin lebih berasal dari prasejarah mitis, salah paham, dan reputasi daripada kenyataan.
claims.quote: The later belief that ancient Spartans had offered human sacrifice to Ares may owe more to mythical prehistory, misunderstandings, and reputation than to reality.

claims.statement: In the Trojan War, Aphrodite, protector of Troy, persuades Ares to take the Trojans' side; the Trojans lose while Athena, Ares's sister, helps the Greeks to victory.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Perang Troya, Aphrodite, pelindung Troya, membujuk Ares memihak bangsa Troya; Troya kalah sementara Athena, saudari Ares, membantu bangsa Yunani menang.
claims.quote: In the Trojan War, Aphrodite, protector of Troy, persuades Ares to take the Trojans' side. The Trojans lose, while Ares's sister Athena helps the Greeks to victory.

claims.statement: Ares's nearest counterpart in Roman religion is Mars, who was given a more important and dignified place as ancestral protector of the Roman people and state.
claims.statement_id: Padanan terdekat Ares dalam agama Romawi adalah Mars, yang diberi kedudukan lebih penting dan terhormat sebagai pelindung leluhur bangsa dan negara Romawi.
claims.quote: Ares's nearest counterpart in Roman religion is Mars, who was given a more important and dignified place in ancient Roman religion as ancestral protector of the Roman people and state.

claims.statement: In Africa, Maḥrem, the principal god of the kings of Aksum before the 4th century AD, was invoked as Ares in Greek inscriptions.
claims.statement_id: Di Afrika, Maḥrem, dewa utama para raja Aksum sebelum abad ke-4 M, disebut sebagai Ares dalam prasasti Yunani.
claims.quote: In Africa, Maḥrem, the principal god of the kings of Aksum prior to the 4th century AD, was invoked as Ares in Greek inscriptions.

claims.statement: Thrace was considered Ares's birthplace and his refuge after the affair with Aphrodite was exposed to the mockery of the other gods.
claims.statement_id: Thrakia dianggap tempat kelahiran Ares dan tempat ia berlindung setelah perselingkuhannya dengan Aphrodite menjadi bahan ejekan para dewa lain.
claims.quote: Thrace was considered to be Ares's birthplace and his refuge after the affair with Aphrodite was exposed to the general mockery of the other gods.

claims.statement: Like most Greek deities, Ares received animal sacrifice; in Sparta after battle he was given an ox for a victory by stratagem or a rooster for victory through onslaught.
claims.statement_id: Seperti kebanyakan dewa Yunani, Ares menerima kurban hewan; di Sparta, setelah pertempuran ia diberi seekor sapi untuk kemenangan lewat siasat atau seekor ayam jantan untuk kemenangan lewat serbuan.
claims.quote: Like most Greek deities, Ares was given animal sacrifice; in Sparta, after battle, he was given an ox for a victory by stratagem, or a rooster for victory through onslaught.

claims.statement: In Renaissance and Neoclassical literary works Ares is replaced by the Roman Mars, a romantic emblem of manly valor rather than the cruel and blood-thirsty god of Greek mythology.
claims.statement_id: Dalam karya sastra masa Renaisans dan Neoklasik, Ares digantikan Mars dari Romawi, lambang romantis keberanian jantan, bukan dewa Yunani yang kejam dan haus darah.
claims.quote: In literary works of these eras, Ares is replaced by the Roman Mars, a romantic emblem of manly valor rather than the cruel and blood-thirsty god of Greek mythology.

claims.statement: His cults in southern Asia Minor are attested from the 5th century BC well into the Roman Imperial era, at 29 sites and on over 70 local coin issues.
claims.statement_id: Kultus Ares di Asia Kecil selatan tercatat sejak abad ke-5 SM hingga masa Kekaisaran Romawi, di 29 lokasi dan lebih dari 70 penerbitan koin lokal.
claims.quote: His cults in southern Asia Minor are attested from the 5th century BC and well into the later Roman Imperial era, at 29 different sites, and on over 70 local coin issues.

claims.statement: The Areopagus ("mount of Ares"), a natural rock outcrop in Athens some distance from the Acropolis, was supposedly where Ares was tried and acquitted by the gods for the revenge-killing of Poseidon's son Halirrhothius, who had raped Ares's daughter Alcippe.
claims.statement_id: Areopagus ("bukit Ares"), singkapan batu alami di Athena yang agak jauh dari Akropolis, konon tempat Ares diadili dan dibebaskan para dewa atas pembunuhan balas dendamnya terhadap Halirrhothius, putra Poseidon, yang memerkosa Alcippe, putri Ares.
claims.quote: The Areopagus ("mount of Ares"), a natural rock outcrop in Athens, some distance from the Acropolis, was supposedly where Ares was tried and acquitted by the gods for his revenge-killing of Poseidon's son, Halirrhothius, who had raped Ares's daughter Alcippe.

claims.statement: Ares' main attribute was a peaked warrior's helm, even in domestic scenes such as feasts of the gods; his other attributes included a shield, a spear, and sometimes a sheathed sword.
claims.statement_id: Atribut utama Ares adalah ketopong prajurit berpuncak, bahkan dalam adegan rumah tangga seperti pesta para dewa; atribut lainnya perisai, tombak, dan kadang pedang bersarung.
claims.quote: Ares' main attribute was a peaked warrior's helm. Even in domestic scenes, such as feasts of the gods, he was depicted either wearing or holding his helm. The god's other attributes included a shield, a spear and sometimes a sheathed sword.

claims.statement: Ares can be quite difficult to identify in ancient Greek art because little distinguishes him from other warrior figures.
claims.statement_id: Ares cukup sulit dikenali dalam seni Yunani kuno karena hanya sedikit yang membedakannya dari tokoh prajurit lain.
claims.quote: Ares can be quite difficult to identify in ancient Greek art as there is little to distinguish him from other warrior figures.

claims.statement: Ares' sacred animal was the serpent; he was also associated with certain birds such as the vulture and a few species of owl, which ancient augury identified as portents of war, sedition, and ill-fortune.
claims.statement_id: Hewan suci Ares adalah ular; ia juga dikaitkan dengan burung tertentu seperti burung nasar dan beberapa jenis burung hantu, yang menurut augury kuno menjadi pertanda perang, hasutan, dan nasib buruk.
claims.quote: Ares' sacred animal was the serpent. He was also associated with certain birds, such as the vulture and a few species of owl, which ancient augury identified as portents of war, sedition and ill-fortune.

claims.statement: The most famous of the god's animals in myth were the Colchian Dragon, a serpent set by Ares to guard the Golden Fleece, and the Ismenian Dragon, a giant snake guarding his sacred spring near Thebes.
claims.statement_id: Hewan Ares yang paling terkenal dalam mitos adalah Naga Kolkhis, ular yang ia tempatkan untuk menjaga Bulu Domba Emas, dan Naga Ismenia, ular raksasa penjaga mata air sucinya dekat Thebai.
claims.quote: The most famous of the god's animals in myth were the Colchian Dragon, a serpent set by Ares to guard the Golden Fleece, and the Ismenian Dragon, a giant snake which guarded his sacred spring near Thebes.

claims.statement: Ares was a son of Zeus and Hera, King and Queen of the Gods, and brother of the goddesses Eileithyia and Hebe.
claims.statement_id: Ares adalah putra Zeus dan Hera, raja dan ratu para dewa, serta saudara dewi Eileithyia dan Hebe.
claims.quote: Ares was a son of Zeus and Hera, King and Queen of the Gods, and brother of the goddesses Eileithyia and Hebe.

claims.statement: Ares had three children by Aphrodite named Deimos (Fear), Phobos (Terror), and Harmonia (Harmony).
claims.statement_id: Ares memiliki tiga anak dengan Aphrodite: Deimos (Ketakutan), Phobos (Kengerian), dan Harmonia (Keselarasan).
claims.quote: Ares had three children by the goddess Aphrodite named Deimos (Fear), Phobos (Terror), and Harmonia (Harmony).

claims.statement: When Aphrodite fell in love with the handsome youth Adonis, Ares grew jealous, transformed himself into a boar, and gored the boy to death while he was hunting.
claims.statement_id: Ketika Aphrodite jatuh cinta pada pemuda tampan Adonis, Ares cemburu, menjelma babi hutan, dan membunuh pemuda itu saat berburu.
claims.quote: When Aphrodite fell in love with the handsome youth Adonis, the god grew jealous, transformed himself into a boar, and gorged the boy to death as he was out hunting.

claims.statement: Ares transformed his daughter Harmonia and her husband Kadmos of Thebes into serpents and had them carried away to the Islands of the Blessed.
claims.statement_id: Ares mengubah putrinya Harmonia dan suaminya Kadmos dari Thebai menjadi ular dan membawa mereka ke Pulau-Pulau Orang Terberkati.
claims.quote: Ares transformed his daughter Harmonia and her husband Kadmos (Cadmus) of Thebes into serpents and had them carried away to the Islands of the Blessed.

claims.statement: Ares slew Hallirhothios to avenge the rape of his daughter Alkippe; he was tried at the court of the Areiopagos in Athens but acquitted of murder.
claims.statement_id: Ares membunuh Hallirhothios untuk membalas pemerkosaan putrinya, Alkippe; ia diadili di pengadilan Areiopagos di Athena tetapi dibebaskan dari tuduhan pembunuhan.
claims.quote: The god slew Hallirhothios to avenge the rape of his daughter Alkippe. He was tried at the court of the Areiopagos in Athens but acquitted of murder.

claims.statement: In the battle between Herakles and Ares' villainous son Kyknos, the god intervened but was wounded by the hero and forced to flee back to Olympos.
claims.statement_id: Dalam pertempuran antara Herakles dan Kyknos yang jahat, putra Ares, sang dewa ikut campur tetapi dilukai sang pahlawan dan terpaksa kembali ke Olimpos.
claims.quote: During the battle between Herakles and Ares' villianous Kyknos (Cycnus), the god intervened but was wounded by the hero and forced to flee back to Olympos.

claims.statement: Ares actively supported his Amazon-queen daughters in their many wars and battles; the most celebrated was Penthesileia, who joined the Trojan War.
claims.statement_id: Ares aktif mendukung putri-putrinya yang menjadi ratu Amazon dalam banyak perang; yang paling terkenal adalah Penthesileia yang ikut dalam Perang Troya.
claims.quote: Ares actively supported his Amazon-queen daughters in their many wars and battles. The most celebrated of these was Penthesileia who joined the Trojan War.

claims.statement: During the Trojan War, Ares, who had sided with the Trojans, was wounded by the Greek hero Diomedes, who drove a spear into his side, sending him flying back to Olympos bellowing in pain.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Perang Troya, Ares yang memihak Troya dilukai pahlawan Yunani Diomedes yang menusukkan tombak ke sisinya, sehingga ia terbang kembali ke Olimpos sambil meraung kesakitan.
claims.quote: During the course of the Trojan War, Ares, who had sided with the Trojans, was wounded by the Greek hero Diomedes who drove a spear into his side, sending him flying back to Olympos bellowing in pain.

claims.statement: According to this dictionary, Ares is nothing but the personification of bold force and strength, less the god of war than of its tumult, confusion, and horrors; Eris calls forth war, Zeus directs its course, but Ares loves war for its own sake.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kamus ini, Ares hanyalah personifikasi kekuatan yang berani, dan lebih sebagai dewa kegaduhan, kekacauan, dan kengerian perang; Eris menyulut perang, Zeus mengarahkannya, tetapi Ares mencintai perang demi perang itu sendiri.
claims.quote: Ares, on the other hand, is nothing but the personification of bold force and strength, and not so much the god of war as of its tumult, confusion, and horrors. His sister Eris calls forth war, Zeus directs its course, but Ares loves war for its own sake

claims.statement: The warlike character of the Thracian tribes led to the belief that the god's residence was in that country, and there and in Scythia were the principal seats of his worship.
claims.statement_id: Watak suku-suku Thrakia yang suka perang melahirkan kepercayaan bahwa Ares tinggal di negeri itu, dan di sana serta di Skithia terdapat pusat utama pemujaannya.
claims.quote: The warlike character of the tribes of Thrace led to the belief, that the god's residence was in that country, and here and in Scythia were the principal seats of his worship.

claims.statement: The temples of this god were usually built outside the towns, probably to suggest that he was to prevent enemies from approaching them.
claims.statement_id: Kuil-kuil Ares biasanya dibangun di luar kota, mungkin untuk menyiratkan bahwa ia akan mencegah musuh mendekat.
claims.quote: The temples of this god were usually built outside the towns, probably to suggest the idea that he was to prevent enemies from approaching them.

claims.statement: In Hesiod's Shield of Heracles, Ares is shown holding a spear, urging on the footmen, red with blood, and standing in his chariot.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Perisai Herakles karya Hesiodos, Ares digambarkan memegang tombak, mendorong pasukan pejalan kaki, merah oleh darah, dan berdiri di keretanya.
claims.quote: deadly Ares the spoil-winner himself. He held a spear in his hands and was urging on the footmen: he was red with blood as if he were slaying living men, and he stood in his chariot.

claims.statement: Homeric Hymn 8 addresses Ares as exceeding in strength, chariot-rider, golden-helmed, shield-bearer, saviour of cities, harnessed in bronze, and mighty with the spear.
claims.statement_id: Himne Homerik 8 menyapa Ares sebagai yang luar biasa kuat, penunggang kereta, berketopong emas, pembawa perisai, penyelamat kota, berbaju perunggu, dan perkasa dengan tombak.
claims.quote: Ares, exceeding in strength, chariot-rider, golden-helmed, doughty in heart, shield-bearer, Saviour of cities, harnessed in bronze, strong of arm, unwearying, mighty with the spear, O defender of Olympos

claims.statement: Ares was the Greek god of war and perhaps the most unpopular of the Olympian gods because of his quick temper, aggressiveness, and unquenchable thirst for conflict.
claims.statement_id: Ares adalah dewa perang Yunani dan mungkin paling tidak populer di antara para dewa Olimpus karena emosinya yang cepat naik, agresivitasnya, dan hausnya yang tak terpuaskan akan pertikaian.
claims.quote: Ares was the Greek god of war. He was perhaps the most unpopular of all the Olympian gods because of his quick temper, aggressiveness, and unquenchable thirst for conflict.

claims.statement: Described by Hesiod in the Theogony as "shield-piercing Ares" and "city-sacking Ares", he represented the more brutal and bloody side of battle, in contrast to Athena, who represented its more strategic elements.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Theogony karya Hesiodos, Ares disebut "Ares penembus perisai" dan "Ares penjarah kota", mewakili sisi pertempuran yang lebih brutal dan berdarah, berbeda dengan Athena yang mewakili unsur strategis perang.
claims.quote: Described by Hesiod in his Theogony as 'shield-piercing Ares' and 'city-sacking Ares,' the god represented the more brutal and bloody side of battle, which was in contrast to Athena who represented the more strategic elements of warfare.

claims.statement: Ares' son Kyknos waylaid pilgrims to the oracle at Delphi, so Apollo sent Hercules; Hercules killed Kyknos, a furious Ares fought him, but Hercules was protected by Athena and even managed to wound Ares.
claims.statement_id: Kyknos, putra Ares, terkenal menghadang peziarah menuju orakel Delphi sehingga Apollo mengirim Hercules; Hercules membunuh Kyknos, Ares yang murka melawannya, tetapi Hercules dilindungi Athena dan bahkan berhasil melukai Ares.
claims.quote: Ares' son Kyknos was infamous for waylaying pilgrims on their way to the oracle at Delphi, and so earned the displeasure of Apollo, who sent Hercules to deal with him. Hercules killed Kyknos, and a furious Ares engaged the hero in a fight. However, Hercules was protected from harm by Athena and even managed to wound Ares.

claims.statement: In Homer's version of the Trojan War in the Iliad, Ares supports the Trojans, sometimes even leading them in battle along with Hector.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi Homeros tentang Perang Troya di Iliad, Ares mendukung bangsa Troya, bahkan kadang memimpin mereka berperang bersama Hektor.
claims.quote: In Homer's version of the Trojan War in the Iliad, Ares supports the Trojans, sometimes even leading them in battle along with Hector.

claims.statement: Ares is roundly beaten by Athena, who, supporting the Achaeans, knocks him out with a large rock.
claims.statement_id: Ares dikalahkan telak oleh Athena, yang membela bangsa Akhaia dan menjatuhkannya dengan batu besar.
claims.quote: Ares is roundly beaten by Athena who, supporting the Achaeans, knocks him out with a large rock.

claims.statement: Fleeing back to Olympus, Ares' complaints are ignored by Zeus, who nonetheless instructs Paieon to heal his wound.
claims.statement_id: Setelah melarikan diri ke Olimpus, keluhan Ares diabaikan Zeus, tetapi Zeus memerintahkan Paieon menyembuhkan lukanya.
claims.quote: Fleeing back to Olympus, Zeus ignores the complaints of Ares but instructs Paieon to heal his wound.

claims.statement: Ares was not commonly worshipped, but there were cult sites with temples on Crete (he is mentioned in Linear B tablets from Knossos) and at Argos, Athens, Erythrae, Geronthrae, Megalopolis, Tegea, Therapne, and Troezen, and he also had a cult in Thrace.
claims.statement_id: Ares tidak lazim dipuja, tetapi ada tempat kultus dengan kuil di Kreta (ia disebut dalam lempeng Linear B dari Knossos) dan di Argos, Athena, Erythrae, Geronthrae, Megalopolis, Tegea, Therapne, dan Troezen; ia juga punya kultus di Thrakia.
claims.quote: Ares was not commonly worshipped but there were cult sites with temples dedicated to the god on Crete (he is mentioned in Linear B tablets from Knossos) and at Argos, Athens, Erythrae, Geronthrae, Megalopolis, Tegea, Therapne, and Troezen. He also had a cult in Thrace

claims.statement: Ares is sometimes shown riding a chariot pulled by fire-breathing horses; the myth of his battle with Hercules was a popular subject for Attic vases in the 6th century BCE.
claims.statement_id: Kadang Ares ditampilkan menaiki kereta yang ditarik kuda penyembur api; mitos pertempurannya melawan Hercules menjadi subjek populer vas Attika pada abad ke-6 SM.
claims.quote: Sometimes the Greek deity is shown riding his chariot pulled by fire-breathing horses. The myth of Ares' battle with Hercules was a popular subject for Attic vases in the 6th century BCE.

claims.statement: In Roman mythology Mars was also the father of Romulus and Remus, the legendary founders of Rome, and the city therefore achieved a sacred status.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Romawi, Mars juga ayah Romulus dan Remus, pendiri legendaris Roma, sehingga kota itu memperoleh status suci.
claims.quote: In Roman mythology, Mars was also the father of Romulus and Remus (through the rape of the Vestal Virgin Rhea Silvia), the legendary founders of Rome, and, therefore, the city achieved a sacred status.

claims.statement: In Greek myths Ares was usually found in the company of his children by Aphrodite, Phobos and Deimos, his sister Eris (Strife), and his charioteer Ennyo.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah mitologi Yunani, Ares biasanya ditemani anak-anaknya dengan Aphrodite, Phobos dan Deimos, saudarinya Eris (Perselisihan), dan kusir keretanya, Ennyo.
claims.quote: In stories from Greek mythology, Ares was usually to be found in the company of his other children with Aphrodite, Phobos (Fear) and Deimos (Terror), with his sister Eris (Strife), and with his charioteer Ennyo.

claims.statement: Hephaistos managed to entrap the lovers in an ingenious bed, a tale told in some detail in Book 8 of Homer's Odyssey; Ares' punishment was temporary banishment from Mount Olympus.
claims.statement_id: Hephaistos berhasil menjebak sepasang kekasih itu dalam ranjang yang cerdik, kisah yang diceritakan cukup rinci dalam Buku 8 Odyssey; hukuman bagi Ares adalah pengusiran sementara dari Gunung Olimpus.
claims.quote: Hephaistos managed to entrap the lovers in an ingenious bed, and the tale is told in some detail in Book 8 of Homer's Odyssey. Once caught, the punishment for Ares' indiscretion was temporary banishment from Mount Olympus.

claims.statement: In the Iliad, Diomedes drives his bronze spear at Ares and Athene speeds it against Ares' lower belly where he is girded with his taslets; when the spear is drawn out, Ares bellows.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Iliad, Diomedes menusukkan tombak perunggu ke Ares dan Athena mengarahkannya ke perut bagian bawah Ares, tempat ia mengenakan pelindung; setelah tombak ditarik, Ares meraung.
claims.quote: Next Diomedes, good at the war-cry, drave at Ares with his spear of bronze, and Pallas Athene sped it mightily against his nethermost belly, where he was girded with his taslets. There did he thrust and smite him, rending the fair flesh, and forth he drew the spear again. Then brazen Ares bellowed

claims.statement: In the Iliad Ares' bellow is as loud as nine or ten thousand warriors crying in battle, and trembling comes upon Achaeans and Trojans alike.
claims.statement_id: Raungan Ares dalam Iliad sekeras teriakan sembilan atau sepuluh ribu prajurit dalam pertempuran, sehingga bangsa Akhaia dan Troya sama-sama gemetar.
claims.quote: loud as nine thousand warriors or ten thousand cry in battle, when they join in the strife of the War-god; and thereat trembling came upon Achaeans alike and Trojans, and fear gat hold of them; so mightily bellowed Ares insatiate of war.

claims.statement: In the Iliad, Otus and Ephialtes, sons of Aloeus, bind Ares in cruel bonds and he lies bound in a brazen jar for thirteen months, and would have perished.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Iliad, Otus dan Ephialtes, putra Aloeus, mengikat Ares dengan belenggu kejam dan ia terikat dalam bejana perunggu selama tiga belas bulan hingga nyaris binasa.
claims.quote: So suffered Ares, when Otus and mighty Ephialtes, the sons of Aloeus, bound him in cruel bonds, and in a brazen jar he lay bound for thirteen months; and then would Ares, insatiate of war, have perished

claims.statement: A later tradition that Hera conceived Ares by touching a certain flower appears to imitate the legend of the birth of Hephaestus and is related by Ovid.
claims.statement_id: Tradisi belakangan bahwa Hera mengandung Ares dengan menyentuh sebuah bunga tampaknya meniru legenda kelahiran Hephaistos dan dituturkan oleh Ovidius.
claims.quote: A later tradition, according to which Hera conceived Ares by touching a certain flower, appears to be an imitation of the legend about the birth of Hephaestus, and is related by Ovid.

claims.statement: According to this dictionary, when Aphrodite loved Adonis, Ares in his jealousy metamorphosed himself into a bear and killed his rival.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kamus ini, ketika Aphrodite mencintai Adonis, Ares karena cemburu menjelma beruang dan membunuh saingannya.
claims.quote: When Aphrodite loved Adonis, Ares in his jealonsy metamorphosed himself into a bear, and killed his rival.

claims.statement: Ares is written Ἄρης in Ancient Greek, transliterated Árēs, and is the Greek god of war and courage.
claims.statement_id: Nama Ares dalam bahasa Yunani Kuno ditulis Ἄρης, dengan transliterasi Árēs; ia adalah dewa perang dan keberanian Yunani.
claims.quote: Ancient Greek: Ἄρης, Árēs ... is the Greek god of war and courage.

claims.statement: Ares was one of the Twelve Olympians in the archaic tradition represented by the Iliad and Odyssey.
claims.statement_id: Ares adalah salah satu dari Dua Belas Dewa Olimpus dalam tradisi arkais yang diwakili Iliad dan Odyssey.
claims.quote: Ares was one of the Twelve Olympians in the archaic tradition represented by the Iliad and Odyssey.
